sa: प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा। अलमेषा परित्रातुं राक्षस्यो महतो भयात्॥
en: If Maithili, the daughter of the king Janaka, be pleased with you (for your imploring her forgiveness) you might be saved from the mighty disaster.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या राम कालेन केनचित्। जनयामास बीभत्सं रक्षोरूपं सुदारुणम्॥ दशग्रीवं महादंष्ट्र नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्। ताम्रोष्ठं विंशतिभुजं महास्यं दीप्तमूर्धनम्॥
en: Having been thus accosted, the girl, O Rama, after a length of time brought forth a very terrible and hideous offspring having the form of a Raksasa, having ten necks, furnished with large teeth, and resembling a heap of collyrium, with coppery lips, twenty arms, huge faces, and flaming hair.

sa: ततस्तु वेगवान् वीरो गिरेनिरिनिभः कपिः। निपपात गिरेस्तस्य शिखरे पादपाकुले॥
en: Then the vehement monkey resembling a hill, having leapt up from that mountain, alighted on the top of that (other) mountain (Mahendra) filled with trees.

sa: दिष्ट्या प्रहस्तो विकटो विरूपाक्षो महोदरः। अकम्पनश्च दुर्धर्षो निहतास्ते निशाचराः॥
en: By good fortune it is that those night-rangers, Prahasta, and Vikata; and Virupāksa, and Mahodara, and the unconquerable Akampana, have all been slain (by you).

sa: चतुभ्यॊऽपि समुद्रेभ्यः संध्यामन्वास्य रावण। इदं मुहूर्तमायाति बाली तिष्ठ मुहूर्तकम्॥
en: However, O Ravana, Vali shall soon return after performing the Sandhya rites at the confluence of the four oceans; therefore wait here for a moment.

sa: न शक्यं सौप्तिकं कर्तुं रामस्य विदितात्मनः। वधश्च पुरुषव्याघ्र यस्मिन्नैवोपपद्यते॥
en: Rāma, acquainted with self, is incapable of being surprised in sleep; nor does the slaying of that tiger-like one commend itself to me as probable.

sa: राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्ष ववर्ष ह। अश्मवर्ष यथा मेघः पक्षिसङ्केषु कानने॥
en: He began to make a downpour of crags at the Rakşasas host like to the cloud pouring down hailstorms at the bird in the forest.

sa: सा वीरसमिति राज्ञा विरराज व्यवस्थिता। शशिना शुभनक्षत्रा पौर्णमासीव शारदी॥
en: With the presence of the king* that assembly of heroes looked beautiful, as does the autumnal night, garnished with beauteous stars, with the Moon. *Rāma.

sa: एकेन वानरेणेयं पूर्वं दग्धा महापुरी। कुमारो निहतश्चाक्षः सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः॥
en: Ere this by a single monkey was this splendid city burnt down. And the prince Akşa has been slain along with his following and elephants.

sa: आग्नेयमत्रं तस्मै स मुमोच धनदस्तदा। राक्षसेन्द्रो वारुणेन तदत्रं प्रत्यवारयत्॥
en: And then the bestower of riches discharged a fiery weapon at him; and thereat the lord of Rāks asa resisted it with a Varuņa weapon.

sa: मनार्यजुष्टं वचनं निशम्य। उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थतत्त्वं विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः॥
en: Hearing these words grounded in unrighteousness, evil every way, and worthy of the base, that foremost of intelligent ones, Vibhișana, spoke words couching supreme import,

sa: पश्येदानों जगच्चित्रमिमं विश्रवसः सुत। मुहूर्त तिष्ठस्व दुर्लभं ते भविष्यति।९।।
en: O Vaiśravaņa, do you observe the variegated universe now wait for a moment after which it will be hard for you to keep your life.

sa: लङ्काविपर्ययं दृष्ट्वा यानि लङ्कालयान्यथ ॥ भूतानि भयदर्शीनि विमनस्कानि सर्वशः।
en: Perceiving the destruction of Lanka hand, those deities that had taken up their quarters there, everywhere were struck with fear and felt their spirits depressed.

sa: तां समीक्ष्य पुरीं लङ्कां राक्षसाधिपतेः शुभाम्। अनुत्तमामृद्धिमतीं चिन्तयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: And seeing the delightful, . divine and prosperous city of Lankā belonging to the lord of Rākşasas, that one endowed with prowess thought within himself,

sa: रावणोऽपि वरं लब्वा पुनरेवागमत्तथा। केनचित्त्वथ कालेन रावणो लोकरावणः॥ पश्चिमार्णवमागच्छत्सचिवैः सह राक्षसः। द्वीपस्थो दृश्यते तत्र पुरुषः पावकप्रभः॥ महाजाम्बूनदप्रख्य एक एव व्यवस्थितः। दृश्यते भीषणाकारो युगान्तानलसंनिभः॥
en: And having obtained the boon Råvaņa too came back. After a few days that Raksasa Ravana, the dread of all people, arrived at the banks of the western Ocean with his councillors. And on the island a person was seen bright as fire under the name of Mahājāmbūnada, seated there alone. He had a dreadful figure and was like to the fire at dissolution.

sa: पूरिता तेन शब्देन सनदीगिरिकानना। संचचाल मही सर्वा त्रस्तसिंहमृगद्विजा ॥
en: With that sound all quarters were filled, and the earth, will rivers, mountains and forests shook and all the lions, deer and birds were terrified.

sa: निर्विशङ्का निरुद्विग्ना निरपेक्षा च मैथिली। मामुपस्थास्यते सीता सर्वाभरणभूषिता ॥
en: Then methyl's daughter, her fear gone off with her anxiety, and herself losing all support, Sītādaughter to methyl-decked out in all ornaments, shall seek me.

sa: तस्य साहाय्यमस्माभिः कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्विह। तेन प्रस्थापितस्तुभ्यं समीपमिह धर्मतः॥
en: It therefore behove us to assist him by all means. And by virtue of this contract I have despatched Hanumān to you as an envoy.

sa: नारायणो मम पतिर्न त्वन्यः पुरुषोत्तमात्। आश्रये नियमं घोरं नारायणपरीप्सया॥
en: Nārāyaṇa is my husband, and not any one else than that best of male beings; and desirous of having Nārāyaṇa I have adopted severe restraints.

sa: यत् तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते॥ प्रीतिसंजननं तस्य प्रदातुं तत् त्वमर्हसि।
en: O you of a blameless person, do you confer on me such a token, as might be recognized by Ráma and conduce to his pleasure.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गी रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं क्रोधाद्रक्षोधिपात्मजम्॥
en: Beholding that beloved spouse of Räma, having a tender and beautiful person, he addressed angrily the son of the lord of Rākşasas with harsh words.

sa: हिंसाभिरुचयो हिंस्युरिमां वा जनकात्मजाम्। विपन्नं स्यात् ततः कार्यं रामसुग्रीवयोरिदम्॥
en: Or the Rākşasas, pernicious as they are, shall kill the daughter of Janaka, and there shall the great work of Rāma and Sugrīva, be spoiled.

sa: देवानां भयभीतानां हरिणा राक्षसर्षभौ। प्रतिज्ञातो वधोऽस्माकं चिन्त्यतां यदिह क्षमम्।।३३
en: to O foremost of Rākşasas, Hari promised to the frightened celestials that he would slay us. Therefore do you think as to what is fit.

sa: तदवस्थाप्यतां बुद्धिरलं देवि विकाङ्गया। विशोकं कुरु वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्॥
en: Do you therefore confide in me, O worshipful dame, and be not suspicious. And O Vaidehi, do you remove Rāma's grief as well as Laksmana's.

sa: हीनं रतिगुणैः सर्वैरभिहन्तारमाहवे। सेना त्यजति संविग्ना नृपतिं तं नरेश्वर॥
en: O lord of men, the soldiers, disgusted, renounce that king who is void of all royal accomplishments, and who uselessly slays soldiers in the conflict.

sa: सकामा भव कैकेयि हतोऽयं कुलनन्दनः। कुलमुत्सादितं सर्वं त्वया कलहशीलया॥
en: O Kaikeyſ, have your wishes attained. Slain has been the son of the race; and the entire race is exterminated by you, partial to dissension.

sa: देवदानवदैत्यानां यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्। अवध्येन त्वया लोकः क्लेष्टुं योग्यो न मानुषः॥
en: The world of man is unworthy of being afflicted by you who are incapable of being destroyed by Deities, Dānavas, Daityas, Yakşas, Gandharvas and Rākşasas.

sa: भवत्प्रसादाद्व्यसनं रावणिप्रभवं महत्। उपायेन व्यतिक्रान्तौ शीघ्रं च बलिनौ कृतौ।॥
en: By your grace we have through means survived the mighty calamity that had sprung from Răvana's son; and we have also speedily been rendered strong.

sa: धरते मारुतिस्तात मारुतप्रतिमो यदि। वैश्वानरसमो वीर्ये जीविताशा ततो भवेत्॥
en: O child, if the wind-god's offspring, resembling his sire himself or (the deity of) fire in prowess, is alive, there is hope for our lives.

sa: एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे लवणार्णवे॥ तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः।
en: O you having expansive eyes, for you, this difficult construction of the bridge was made by me over the deep by the help of Nala.

sa: त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्विचेष्टन्तो रामप्रियचिकीर्षवः। यन्निमित्तं हि युध्यामो हता सा जनकात्मजा॥
en: That daughter of Janaka has been slain, for whom we have engaged in fight, renouncing all hope of life and desiring to accomplish Rāma's satisfaction.

sa: अन्योन्यं सहसा दृप्ता निर्वहन्ति क्षिपन्ति च। पतन्तश्चोत्पतन्त्यन्ये पातयन्त्यपरे परान्॥
en: And some in pride (of strength) suddenly raised others and threw them down. And some fell and were anon up, and some brought others down.

sa: एतानिहन्तुमिच्छामि समरश्लाघिनो ह्यहम्। एतैः प्रमथितं सर्वं रक्षसां दृश्यते बलम्॥
en: Those, pluming themselves overmuch on their martial worth, I intended to slay in battle. And all this Rākşasa force appeared to be harassed by these.

sa: राक्षसाश्च विनिष्पिष्टाः खरश्च निहतो रणे। दूषणं चाग्रतो हत्वा त्रिशिरास्तदनन्तरम्॥
en: All the Raksasas were grinded (to death) by Rāghava. Khara was slain in the conflict; Dūşaņa being slain first Triſiră was slain thereafter by him.

sa: मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्यामितौजसः। भ्रातॄणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च॥
en: O large armed one, the life of Rāghava of unmitigated prowess, those of his brothers and of your royal race are all subject to me.

sa: केचिद्विनिहता भूमौ रुधिरार्दा वनौकसः। केचिद्विद्राविता नष्टाः संक्रुद्धै राक्षसैर्युधि ॥
en: Some among the monkeys lay slain on the ground, drenched in blood. and some, fleeing away from the field, were slaughtered by the infuriated Rākşasas.

sa: धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः। इयं सा दयिता भार्या राक्षसीवशमागता॥
en: And She is the beloved spouse of the pious and grateful Rāma, knowing his ownself, and has been brought under the control of the Raksasis.

sa: इत्येवं दैवतैरुक्तो देवदेवो जनार्दनः। अभयं भयदोऽरीणां दत्त्वा देवानुवाच ह॥
en: Thus accosted by the deities, that god of gods Janārdana who brings fear to foes cheering up the celestial up the celestials, said to them.

sa: राक्षसान्समरे हृष्टान्सानुबन्धान्मदोद्धतान्। नुद त्वं नो भयं देव नीहारमिव भास्करः॥
en: Slay in encounter the elated Rākşasas along with their adherents; and even as the sun dried up dew, do you dispel this fear of ours.

sa: रक्षसा तेन बाणौधैनिकृत्ता सा सहस्रधा। निपपात तदा भूमौ गृध्रचक्रमिवाकुलम्॥
en: And being sundered into a thousand pieces by the arrow of that Rākşasa, it fell down on the earth like to a band of vultures.

sa: स महात्मा समुद्यस्य कालदण्डोपमां गदाम्। प्रविवेश ततः सैन्यं नयन्यक्षान्यमक्षयम्॥
en: And that high-souled one, raising up his mace resembling the rod itself of Time, entered into that army, despatching Yakşas to the abode of Yama.

sa: प्रच्छन्नौ च विमुञ्चेमौ चारौ रात्रिंचरावुभौ। शत्रुपक्षस्य सततं विभीषण विकर्षिणौ॥
en: And albeit these night-rangers have come as spies in disguise, with the view of creating division among their foes, yet, O Vibhisana, let them off.

sa: वैनतेयेन संस्पृष्टास्तयोः संरुरुहुव्रणाः। सुवर्णे च तनू स्निग्धे तयोराशु बभूवतुः॥
en: Their wounds, on being touched by Vinata's son, were (immediately) healed: and the bodies of both speedily became cool and shone with an excellent complexion.

sa: एवमुक्तः कुशास्तीणे तीरे नदनदीपतेः। संविवेश तदा रामो वेद्यामिव हुताशनः॥
en: Being thus addressed Räma reached the shore of the lord of rivers and streams, covered with Kusa, like to fire getting into the sacrificial dais.

sa: विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं संगृहीतं तु रक्षसा। अगमद्धनदं वेगाद्रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् ॥
en: That celestial car Puspaka had been taken away by the Raksasa (Ravana); but now at the words Rāma it reached (again) the Giver of wealth.

sa: सूर्ये चास्तं गते रात्रौ देहं संक्षिप्य मारुतिः। वृषदंशकमात्रोऽथ बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः॥
en: On the sun having set, at night the Windgod's son, contracting his person, reducing himself to the dimensions of a cat, became wonderful to behold.

sa: अथवा नहि तस्यार्थो धर्मकामस्य धीमतः। मया रामस्य राजर्षेर्भार्यया परमात्मनः॥
en: Or that highly intelligent royal ascetic desirous of securing piety and freed from the troubles of life, has no need of a wife like me.

sa: रावणोऽथ महातेजास्तं शृङ्गं सप्तभिः शरैः। आजधान सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैस्तद्धिशीणं पपात ह।७३।।
en: The highly powerful Rāvana, by means of seven shafts with sharpened points, hit at the mountain-top; and shivered in pieces, it fell (to the earth).

sa: युध्यमानौ ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रसक्तौ नरराक्षसौ। प्रभिन्नाविव मातंगौ परस्परजयैषिणौ॥ तयायुद्धं द्रष्टुकामो वरचापधरो बली। शूरः स रावणभ्राता तस्थौ संग्राममूर्धनि ॥
en: Seeing the man and the Rākṣasa engaged in battle, with their whole soul, each eager to beat the other, like to elephants with the temporal juice trickling from their temples, desirous of beholding their encounter, Răvaņa's mighty and heroic brother, bearing an excellent bow, stood in front of the arena.

sa: सर्वात्मना पर्यनुनीयमानो यदा न सौमित्रिरुपैति योगम्। नियुज्यमानो ततोऽभ्यषिञ्चद्भरतं महात्मा॥
en: When the son of Sumitrā did not accept the heir apparentship albeit solicited earnestly again and again, the high-souled (Rāma) conferred upon Bharata that dignity.

sa: अत्र सा मृगशावाक्षी मत्कृते जनकात्मजा। पीड्यते शोकसंतप्ता कृशा स्थण्डिलशायिनी॥
en: For my sake, here that one. Janaka's daughter, having eyes resembling those of a young deer, is undergoing affliction; and Leith down on the ground.

sa: तमुवाच महातेजाः पौलस्त्यमपराजितम्। समाह्वये त्वां समरे सम्यग्युद्धं प्रयच्छ मे।९।।
en: The highly powerful Lakşmaņa addressed Pulastya's son never knowing defeat, saying, I challenge you to the encounter. Do you give me battle, exerting your utmost.

sa: त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। त्वामेव भगवन्सर्वे प्रविशन्ति युगक्षये॥
en: You have created the three worlds, the mobile and immobile, and in you all these shall, O glorious deity, end at the time of dissolution.

sa: कामं तिष्ठ महाराज निर्गमिष्याम्यहं रणे। उद्धरिष्यामि ते शत्रूनगरुडः पन्नगानिव॥
en: But stay at your pleasure, O mighty sovereign, I will go out to battle; and even as Garuda capture serpents, will I capture your enemies.

sa: ते कृताञ्जलयः सर्वे रथस्थं पृथिवीस्थिताः॥ राक्षसा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं शिरोभिस्तं ववन्दिरे।
en: All those Rākşasas standing on the ground with joined hands, bowed down their heads to the foremost of Rākşasas who was seated on his car.

sa: क्षिप्रं प्रहर निःशङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि। ततस्त्वां ज्ञातविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर॥
en: Strike you swift maugre fear; and acquire lasting renown. And, O monkey, having (at first) taken the measure of your might, will I finish you.

sa: ततः संभाविततरां कालेनापि दुरासदाम्। जग्राह विपुलां शक्ति दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा।२२।।
en: Then (Ravana) took up a huge dart, glowing in its own energy, celebrated as being irresistible, and incapable of being borne by the Destroyer himself.

sa: क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं सह वानरैः। त्वमप्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्र विभीषण॥
en: O Sugrīva, do you soon ascend the car along with the monkeys. Do you ascend too, O Vibhisana, lord of Raksasas, with all your courtiers.

sa: गच्छोपवासं काकुत्स्थं कारयाद्य तपोधन। श्रेयसे राज्यलाभाय वध्वा सह यतव्रत॥
en: O you, having asceticism for your wealth, go, to Kākutstha, and for his welfare and obtaining the kingdom, make him fast along with my daughter-in-law.

sa: तमब्रवीत् समागम्य स राजा धर्मवित्तमम्। किमागमनमाचक्ष्व भगवन् कृतमेव तत्॥ एवमुक्तः स विप्रर्षिः सुद्युम्नमिदमब्रवीत्। प्रतिश्रुत्य करिष्येति श्रुत्वा तत् कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Meeting with him, the king addressed that best of all persons conversant with duties, saying,-Tell me, O reverend sir, why you have Know it is already accomplished.-Thus accosted, that Rishi said to Sudyumna,-Do you promise first that you will do it. You should then, after hearing me, fulfil that promise.

sa: सोमदापि सुतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्य सदृशीं क्रियाम्। यथान्यायं च गन्धवीं स्नुषास्ताः प्रत्यनन्दत। स्पृष्ट्वा च ताः कन्याः कुशनाभं प्रशस्य च॥
en: And the Gandharvī Somadā rejoiced exceedingly at the completion of the nuptials of her son; and embracing her daughters-in-law again and again, and extolling her son, she expressed the fullness of her joy. And he dismissed that lord of earth, king Brahmadatta, in company with his consorts and the priests.

sa: तस्य भार्या बभूवेष्टा ह्यञ्जनेति परिश्रुता। जनयामास तस्यां वै वायुरात्मजमुत्तमम्॥
en: Kesari had a well-known wife by the name of Añjanā to whom he was greatly attached. The deity Wind begot on Añjană an excellent son.

sa: शालिशूकनिभाभासं प्रासूतेमं तदाञ्जना। फलान्याहतुकामा वै निष्क्रान्ता गहने वरा ॥
en: Repairing to a dense forest for collecting fruits, the excellent damsel gave birth to Hanumān resembling the tip of a ſala tree and went away.

sa: चन्द्रांशुकिरणाभाश्च हाराः कासांचिदुद्रताः। हंसा इव बभुः सुप्ताः स्तनमध्येषु योषिताम्॥
en: And the pearl chains of some shining females resembling moon beams, having got topsy-turvy, was lying like sleeping swans between the breasts of the damsels.

sa: इन्द्रियाण्येव तत् सर्वं यत् स्वर्गनरकावुभौ। निगृहीतविसृष्टानि स्वर्गाय नरकाय च॥
en: Heaven and hell both are dependent on our senses. When subdued, they lead us to heaven and when indulged in, they lead us to hell.

sa: यदा स्कन्दः पतिर्लब्धः शाश्वतो देवसेनया। तदा तमाश्रयल्लक्ष्मीः स्वयं देवी शरीरिणी॥ श्रीजुष्टः पञ्चमी स्कन्दस्तस्माच्छ्रीपञ्चमी स्मृता। षष्ठ्यां कृतार्थोऽभूद्यस्मात्तस्मात् षष्ठी महातिथिः॥
en: When Skanda was married to Devasena, the goddess of wealth in her embodied form waited upon him with diligence. As Skanda attained celebrity on the fifth lunar day, it was called Sripanchami; and as he obtained his object in the sixth, that day was considered to be a great tihi.

sa: असमर्थं परित्राणे पोषणे तु शुचिस्मिते। सा त्वं च्यवनमुत्सृज्य वरयस्वैकमावयोः॥
en: O lady of sweet smiles, one who is in incapable of protecting and supporting u? Therefore abandoning Chyavana, accept one of us as your husband.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो राजानः पृथिवीपते। धनंजयसखा चात्र नित्यमास्ते स्म तुम्बुरुः॥ उपासते महात्मानमासीनं सप्तविंशतिः। चित्रसेनः सहामात्यो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥ गीतवादित्रकुशलाः साम्यतालविशारदाः। प्रमाणेऽथ लये स्थाने किन्नराः कृतनिश्रमाः॥ संचोदितास्तुम्बुरुणा गन्धर्वसहितास्तदा। गायन्ति दिव्यतानैस्ते यथान्यायं मनस्विनः। पाण्डुपुत्रानृषींश्चैव रमयन्त उपासते॥ तस्यां सभायामासीनाः सुव्रताः सत्यसंगराः। दिवीव देवा ब्रह्माणं युधिष्ठिरमुपासते॥
en: O lord of the earth, these and many other kings, (waited upon Yudhishthira) the friend of Dhananjaya (Arjuna) Tumbaru, Chitrasena with his ministers, and many other Gandharvas and Apsaras, all well-skilled in singing and playing music, and expert in cadence, and also the Kinnaras, well-skilled in measures and motions, all at the command of Tumbaru waited upon and amused the sons of Pandu and so did also the Rishis (that were present there) by singing celestials songs in proper and charming voice. Those best of men, those best of men, those men of rigid vows, those men with heart devoted to truth all waited upon Yudhishthira, as the celestials wait upon Brahma in heaven.

sa: यजतः पुत्रकामस्य कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः। साहाय्यमृषयो देवा गन्धर्वाश्च ददुः किल॥
en: When Prajapati Kashyapa from the desire of begetting offspring was engaged in a sacrifice, the Rishis, the Devas and the Gandharvas all gave him help.

sa: चरन्तं ब्राह्मणं कञ्चित् कल्पचित्तमनामयम्। पप्रच्छ राजा प्रह्लादो बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिसम्मतम्॥
en: Once on a time king Prahlada endued with great intelligence, enquired of a wandering Brahmana of great intelligence and of a purified and tranquil soul.

sa: विज्ञायैषामशक्तिं च क्रियतां च महाबल। सीता तवानवद्याङ्गी भार्यात्वे राक्षसेश्वर॥
en: Understanding their incapacity, do you, O lord of Rākṣasas, for making her your wife, by force carry away the frail Sītā of a blameless person.

sa: वरुणादाहृतं पूर्वं मयैतत् पार्थकारणात्। गाण्डीवं धनुषां श्रेष्ठं वरुणायैव दीयताम्॥
en: This foremost of hows viz., Gandiva, was procured by me from Varuna for the us of Partha. let it be made over to Varuna himself.

sa: पाण्डवाश्च महात्मानो द्रौपदी च यशस्विनी। कृतोपवासाः कौरव्य प्रययुः प्रामुखस्ततः॥
en: Meanwhile the great Pandavas, O you of Kuru's race, and the illustrious Draupadi, having observed the preminary fast, started with their faces towards he est.

sa: आपत्सु यो धारयति धर्म धर्मविदुत्तमः। व्यसनं ह्येव धर्मस्य धर्मिणामापदुच्यते॥
en: He who keeps his virtue (even) in distress in the foremost of all virtuous men. Distress is the greatest danger to virtue and virtuous men.

sa: आभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम्। शनैर्जगाम सापेक्षो दृष्टिं तत्राविचालयन्॥
en: Going round with reverence the house of installation full of necessary articles, not turning away from it his wistful look, Rāma began to proceed slowly.

sa: ददर्श तत्र गोविन्दं ब्राह्मण वपुषान्वितम्। तेनैव दृष्टपूर्वेण सादृश्येनैव सूचितम्॥
en: He saw Govinda gifted with his Brahmaform. It took after that form of his which had been seen before and which, therefore, helped the recognition

sa: मद्रराजे हते राजन् विरथे कृतवर्मणि॥ दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्।
en: The king of the Madras being slain and upon Kritavarma having been made carless, the entire arıny of Duryodhana fled away from the battle field.

sa: समुच्छ्रितं दन्तशलाकमस्य सुपाण्डुरं छत्रमतीव भाति। प्रदक्षिणं चैनमुपाचरन्त महर्षयः संस्तुतिभिर्महेन्द्रम्॥
en: His milk-white umbrella, with ivory handle, held over his head, looked exceedingly beautiful. Many great Rishis walked round the king uttering the words of praise.

sa: स एवमुक्तोऽङ्गिरसा कौसल्यो राजसत्तमः। प्रयत्नात् कृतवान् वीरः प्रजानां परिपालनम्॥
en: That best of kings viz., the heroic Vasumanas, king of Koshala, thus instructed by Brihaspati the son of Angiras, began thenceforth to protect his subjects.'

sa: गृहाणेमां महाबाहो रक्षस्व कुलमात्मनः। त्वया विभ्रंशिता हीयं भर्तारं नाधिगच्छति॥
en: Accept this lady, O you of long arms, and perpetuate your family. Being severed from the path of rectitude by yourself she gets no husband."

sa: ततोऽस्मान् सुपरिश्रान्तां स्तपसा चातिकर्शितान्॥ उवाच स्वस्थं किमपि भूतं तत्राशरीरकम्।
en: We had been greatly tired. Our penances had einaciated us. At that time, a bodiless Being addressed us from the sky and said to us

sa: शकुन्तानामिवाकाशे मत्स्यानामिव चोदके। यथा गतिर्न दृश्येत तथा ज्ञानविदां गतिः॥
en: Indeed, the road which is followed by men of knowledge is as invisible as that of birds in the sky or of fish in water.

sa: रत्यर्थं भवतां ह्येषा निर्मिता शूलपाणिना। द्रुपदस्य कुले जाता भवद्भिश्चोपजीविता॥
en: For your satisfaction was created by the wielder of the trident. She was born in the race of Drupada and was enjoyed by you all.

sa: श्रेयसस्ते परः कालः प्राप्तो भरतसत्तम। येनाभिभविता शत्रून् रणे पार्थोधनुर्धरः॥
en: Vyasa said: O best of the Bharatas, that prosperous time has come when the son of Pritha, Dhananjaya (Arjuna), will kill your enemies in battle.

sa: तेन विद्राव्यमाणास्ते पाण्डवाः सर्वतो दिशम्। त्रातारं नाभ्यगच्छन्तः स्वेष्वनीकेषु भारत॥
en: Thus routed by hiin on all directions, the Pandava troops, O Bharata, did not find, in their whole host, an one competent to save them.

sa: देवाः अग्नौ समिद्धे स जुहोति यो विद्वान् ब्राह्मणमुखेनाहुति जुहोति॥
en: That learned man who offers food into the mouth of a Brahmana is said to pour libations into the sacred fire for pleasing the gods.

sa: ममैवाभिमुखं स्थित्वा पृच्छ त्वं हरिपुङ्गव। प्रयोजनं प्रवेशस्य वनस्यास्य धनुर्धरौ॥
en: O best of monkeys, do you ask them why they have entered this forest, if you do perceive that these two archers are pure souled.

sa: जघान पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकान् रणमूर्धनि। तेन पाण्डवसैन्यानां सूदिता युधि वारणाः॥
en: Slaughtered the soldiers of Pandu's son on the field of battle. In consequence of showers of weapons, many elephants of the Pandava host were killed.

sa: स तु भीष्मोरणश्लाघी सोमकान् सहसंजयान्। पञ्चालांश्च महेष्वासान् पातयामास सायकैः॥
en: But Bhishma ever proud in battle, began to fell with his shafts, the Somakas, the Srinjayas and the Panchalas, all mighty wielders of the bow.

sa: जनकस्य कुले जाता रामपत्नी सुमध्यमा। कथमुत्पलपत्राक्षी रावणस्य वशं व्रजेत्॥
en: How can the slender-waisted wife of Rāma, born in the race of Janaka, furnished with eyes resembling lotus petals, come under the sway of Ravana?

sa: धिक्कष्टमिति निःश्वस्य राजा शोकपरिप्लुतः। मूर्च्छितो न्यपतत् तस्मिन् पर्यङ्के हेमभूषिते॥
en: 'Oh fie!' 'what affliction' sobbing hard with these words, the monarch, filled with sorrow, swooned away and fell down upon the sofa, embellished with gold.

sa: अभूतपूर्वं संग्रामे तदा देवासुरेऽपि च। वदुर्वाताः सनिर्घाता: पेतुरुल्काः सहस्रशः॥
en: Such things had never happened, not even during the war between the Devas and the Danavas. The winds blew with thunder; meteors fell in thousands;

sa: लक्षयित्वा त्रिगर्तानां तौ प्रविष्टौ रथव्रजम्। अग्रतः सूर्यदत्तश्च मदिराक्षश्च पृष्ठतः॥
en: (Heroes) (began an encounter) hand-tohand, hair to hair and car to car. And marking they entered into the collection of cars belonging to the Trigartas.

sa: ते त्रिगर्ताश्च मत्स्याश्च संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः। अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तो गोषु गृद्धा महाबलाः॥
en: The mighty and powerful Trigartas and Matsya's, both worked up with ire and irrepressible in battle, desirous of possessing kine, sent up a loud war-cry.

sa: नेदृशं बन्धुमासाद्य बान्धवः सुखमेधते। अवृत्त्यैव विपत्स्यामो वयं राष्ट्रात् प्रवासिताः॥
en: Friends derive no happiness from gaining such a friend; being exiled from a kingdom we shall die destitute of the means of earning our livelihood,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अनुज्ञातोधर्मराज्ञा पुत्रं सस्मार राक्षसम्। घटोत्कचस्तुधर्मात्मा स्मृतमात्रः पितुस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been ordered by Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) he remembered his Rakshasa son. As soon as remembered the high-souled Ghatotkacha appeared before his father.

sa: अत ऊर्ध्वं महाराज गुणस्यैतस्य तत्त्वतः। महात्मभिरनुप्रोक्तां कालसंख्यां निबोध मे॥
en: After this, O king, listen to me as I tell you the durations of time as said by the learned regarding these principles or attributes.

sa: अन्यायेन तथोक्तस्तु विदुरो विदुषां वरः। नाभ्यनन्दद् वचो भ्रातुर्वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: The foremost of all learneu men, Vidura, did not approve the words of his brothers so unjustly uttered; and he then thus spoke to him.

sa: ततो द्विजा वसिष्ठेन सार्धमष्टौ प्रवेशिताः। राजानं देवसंकाशं वर्धस्वेति ततोऽब्रुवन्॥
en: There upon having entered the apartment in the company of Vasiştha, eight Brāhmaṇas blessed the king Rāma, resembling a celestial, saying 'may victory crown you.'

sa: कीर्ति प्रथयता लोके पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च भूरिद्रविणतेजसाम्॥
en: He has done this, desiring to spread the fame, throughout the world, of the great Pandavas as also of other Kshatriyas endued with profuse energy.

sa: ततो भीमस्तत्र राजन्नुषित्वा त्रिदश क्षपाः। सत्कृत: शिशुपालेन ययौ सबलवाहनः॥
en: O king, having been duly entertained by Shishupala, Bhima lived there for thirty nights. He then set out from Chedi with his troops and vehicles.

sa: शराचितशरीरं हि तीव्रव्रणमुदीक्ष्य च। शर्म नोपलभे वीर दुष्कृतान्येव चिन्तयन्॥
en: Seeing your body covered with arrows and bad sores, I cannot get, O hero, any peace of mind. thinking of the evils I have done.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रेण सहिता गान्धारी च यशस्विनी॥ पत्नीभ्यां सहितः पाण्डुर्महेन्द्रसदनं ययौ।
en: The famous Gandhari gained the same regions with her husband Dhritarashtra. With his two wives, Pandu went to the abode of the great Indra. as

sa: हेतुकारणसंयुक्तं हितं वचनमुत्तमम्। उच्यमानं महाबाहो न मे विप्राय रोचते॥
en: These beneficial and excellent words, pregnant with reason, which you, O mightyarmed one, have said, do not scem acceptable to me, O foremost of Brahmanas.

sa: अस्त्रग्रामश्च माहेन्द्रो रौद्रः कौबेर एव च। याम्यश्च वारुणश्चैव गदाचोग्रप्रदर्शनाः॥
en: Groups of arms presented by the great Indra and Rudra and Kuvera and Yama and Varuna and a mace which is fierce to look at,

sa: ततः प्रभाते विमले विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्। उवाच राघवो वाक्यं कृताह्निकमरिंदमः॥
en: Then in the morning which happened to be bright, that subduer of his foes, Raghu's descendant, addressed the ascetic Viśvāmitra, who had finished his devotion.

sa: तत्रैव च महाराज यक्षिणी लोकविश्रुताम्। स्नात्वाभिगम्य राजेन्द्र सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O great king, there is the celebrated Tirtha called Yakshini; O king of kings, going and bathing in that Tirtha one's all desires are fulfilled.

sa: मम विद्धि सुतं धर्ममग्रजं द्विजसत्तम॥ मानसं दयितं विप्र सर्वभूतदयात्मकम्।
en: Know, O best of twice-born persons, that Dharma is my eldest-born offspring, originated from my mind, O learned Brahmana, whose essence is for all creatures.

sa: राजान ऊचुः राजधर्मगुणोपेताः सर्वधर्मगुणान्विताः। दोहित्रास्ते वयं राजन् दिवमारोह पार्थिव॥
en: The kings said O king, we are your grandsons endued with kingly virtues and with all virtues and accomplishments; ascend heaven, O ruler of men.

sa: ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नः संस्कृतो वेदपारगः। विप्रो भवति धर्मात्मा क्षत्रियः स्वेन कर्मणा॥
en: Gifted with knowledge and science, purified from all dross, and fully conversant with the Vedas, a pious Kshatriya, by his own deeds, becomes, a Brahmana.

sa: न चैवात्राधिगच्छामि सर्वस्यास्य विनिश्चयम्। एतदिच्छामि कार्येन सत्यं श्रोतुं तपोधन॥
en: I cannot comprehend your motive. ( you having penances for wealth, I wish to hear the truth about all those acts of yours in full.

sa: सर्वेषामेव पर्याप्तो राक्षसानामहं युधि। किं तु रामस्य प्रीत्यर्थं विषहिष्येऽहमीदृशम्॥
en: I can slay all these Rākşasas in battle; but I suffer this (maltreatment) for not marring the (pure delight) Rāma shall derive from my deed.

sa: ततो हनूमान् संत्यज्य भिक्षुरूपमरिंदमः॥ काष्ठयोः स्वेन रूपेण जनयामास पावकम्।
en: Then that subduer of foes, Hanumān, leaving off the guise of a beggar, in his native shape produced a fire with two pieces of wood.

sa: विधूय तान् बाणगणान् ये मुक्ताः पार्थिवोत्तमैः॥ पाण्डवानामदीनात्मा व्यगाहत वरूथिनीम्।
en: Then baffling all those arrows shot by those foremost rulers of earth, that warrior of unrepressed soul (Bhishma) penetrated into the ranks of the Pandavas.

sa: इच्छतोपेक्षितो नाशः कुरूणां मधुसूदन। यस्मात् त्वया महाबाहो फलं तस्मादवाप्नुहि॥
en: Since deliberately, O slayer of Madhu, you were indifferent to this universal destruction therefore, O mighty-armed one, you should feel the consequences of this act.

sa: कथं त्वं कर्मणा शक्तः कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः। करिष्यसि पितुर्वाक्यमधर्मिष्ठं विगर्हितम् ॥
en: Why shall you, being capable of work, conform to these impious and cursed words of your father, who is sadly under the influence of Kaikeyi.

sa: एते चान्ये महीपाला योधास्तव च पाण्डव। गन्धर्वसहिता यान्ति यक्षपुण्यजनैस्तथा॥
en: These and other kings, O son of Pandu, who had fought on your behalf now walk with the Gandharvas or Yakshas or other sacred, beings.

sa: तत्त्वेतत् समतिक्रम्य निरयं गन्तुमिच्छसि। मैथिलीमपि या हि त्वमीक्षसे चीरवासिनीम्॥
en: But since, going beyond that promise of mine, you behold Mithala's daughter dressed in mendicant garb, surely you wish to find your way to hell.

sa: पास्यामि तावत् पानीयमिति पार्थो वृकोदरः। ततोऽभ्यधावत् पानीयं पिपासुः पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Let me therefore, (first) drink water.” Then, Vrikodara, the son of Pritha and the best of the Bharatas, desirous of drinking, rushed towards the water.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच काम्बोजं पश्य दुर्धर्षं काम्बोजास्तरणोचितम्। शयानमृषभस्कन्धं हतं पांसुषु माधव॥
en: Gandhari said Behold that irresistible king of Kambojas, that bull-necked hero lying in the dust, O Madhava, though worthy of sleeping comfortable on Kamboja blankets.

sa: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रे च सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे। त्वं समेष्यसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी॥
en: On the lord of Rākṣasas being slain along with his counsellors and friends, you shall meet with Rāma, even as Rohinī meet with the Moon.

sa: पुराणि न च तं शेकुर्दानवाः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्॥ शरं कालाग्निसंयुक्तं विष्णुसोमसमायुतम्।
en: The denizens of those cities, the Danavas, then could not look at that arrow composed of the Fire of Dissolution and of Vishnu and Soma.

sa: अश्विनाविव रूपेण तेजसा च समन्वितौ। एते चमूमुपगताः स्मरन्तः क्लेशमुत्तमम्॥
en: Like the Ashvins in beauty and endued also with energy these two will fight in the very van on their army remembering their hard sufferings.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त शैनेयं शलभाः पावकं यथा। युक्ताश्च पर्वतीयानां रथाः पाषाणयोधिनाम्॥
en: Rushed against Sini's grandson like flights of insects falling upon a blazing fire. Five hundred other warriors united together, O king, then also assailed Satyaki.

sa: अहन्यहनि शूराणां कुर्वाणः कदनं महत्॥ शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य घातितस्ते पितामहः।
en: Having daily bought about a great carnage of heroic warriors, you at last caused the grandshire to be slain by placing Shikhandin to the front.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ तु रभसौ कृतास्त्रौ युद्धदुर्मदौ। अभ्ययातां त्वरायुक्तौ जिगीषन्तौ परंतप॥
en: The two energetic sons of Madri, masters of weapons and invincible in battle, proceeded quickly against your army worked up with the desire of victory.

sa: खरं तु विरथं रामो गदापाणिमवस्थितम्। मृदुपूर्वं महातेजाः परुषं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: And to Khara deprived of his car standing with a mace in his hand, that exceedingly energetic one, Rāma, precluding his speech with mildness, spoke.

sa: अहन्यहनि पार्थानां वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः। भीष्मो दश सहस्राणि जघान परवीरहा।॥
en: The old grandsire of the Kurus, viz., Bhishma that slayer of hostile heroes day after day slaughtered ten thousand warriors belonging to the Pandava host.

sa: वमन्ति पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरा ववाविशे। अन्तरिक्षात्पपातोल्का वायुश्च परुषं ववौ॥
en: And dreadful jackals, emitting live flames from their mouths, set up cries. And stars began to shoot from the firmament; and the winds to ruffle.

sa: इत्युक्तो भीमसेनेन प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलं प्रति धर्मात्मा सर्वबुद्धिमतां वरः॥
en: Thus addressed by Bhimasena, Yudhishthira said, with respect to Nakula, these words:—'He was of righteous soul and the foremost of all persons gifted with intelligence.

sa: पर्यायैर्हन्यमानानामभियोक्तो न विद्यते। दुःखमेतत् तु यद् द्वेष्टा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते॥
en: Men are affected by pleasure and pain that come by turns in Time. There is no personal agency in this matter. In this lies sorrow.

sa: कृतज्ञः सत्यसंधश्च सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः। रामं तथागतं दृष्ट्वा ततस्त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्॥
en: Seeing Rāma in that plight, the lord of the monkeys, Sugrīva, grateful and having his heart fast fixed in truth, shall give up his life.

sa: ततो न्यवर्तत बलं तावकं भरतर्षभ। शरैः प्रणुन्नं बहुधा पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः॥
en: Then your army, O best of Bharata's race, wounded greatly with arrows by the Pandavas eager for victory, took to their heels in the battle.

sa: महारजतसंकाशा जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः॥ ब्रह्मलोकच्युताः सर्वे सर्वे सर्वेषु साधवः।
en: The men born there possess complexion like gold. They have all descendent from the abode of Brahma, and thcy are all utterers of the Vedas.

sa: सोऽभ्युपेत्य तदा पार्थो मातरं भ्रातृवत्सलः। अभिवाद्याब्रवीत् कुन्तीमम्ब भीम इहागतः॥
en: The son of Pritha, (Yudhisthira), full of filial love, went to his mother, Kunti and making obeisance to her he said, “Has Bhima come here?

sa: तांस्तु प्रपतितान् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवः श्वेतवाहनः। पपात शोकसन्तप्तस्ततो नु परवीरहा॥
en: Seeing Nakula and the others fall down Pandu's son Arjuna of white horses, that destroyer of hostile heroes, fell down in great grief of heart.

sa: ततः प्रसादयामासुरुमां रुद्रं च ते सुराः। अभवच पुनर्बाहुर्यथाप्रकृति वज्रिणः॥
en: Then the celestials gratified both Uma and Maheswara with eulogies. Then the arm of the wielder of the thunderbolt once more regained its natural state.

sa: स रामभवनं प्राप्य पाण्डुराभ्रधनप्रभम्। तिस्रः कक्ष्या रथेनैव विवेश मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: And that foremost of ascetics, having reached Rāma's sable hued residence resembling a mass of clouds, passed through three several apartments, mounted on the car.

sa: आत्मनश्च विपर्यासं भविष्यं भ्रातृभिः सह। ततः पुत्रद्वयं वीरः सोऽभ्यषिञ्चन्नराधिपः॥
en: He also communicated to them his own destruction with his brothers. There upon the king Satrughna determined upon installing his two sons in the kingdom.

sa: शरैः सुपूर्णाविषुधी परंतपः। महद्धनुः सज्जमुपोह्य लक्ष्मणो निशामतिष्ठत् परितोऽस्य केवलम्॥
en: Fastening on his back a pair of quivers filled with arrows furnished with finger-fences, and taking his mighty bow, Lakşmaņa all night kept watch around.

sa: नकुलस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य शासनात्। प्राद्रवद् यत्र पानीयं शीघ्रं चैवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Saying “be it so" Nakula, at the command of his eldest brother, quickly, proceeded towards the spot where the water was and soon reached it.

sa: क्रौञ्चस्य कुशलो देशो वामनस्य मनोनुगः। मनोनुगात् परश्चोष्णो देशः कुरुकुलोद्वह॥
en: The country near Krauncha is called Kushala, that near Vainana is Manonuga that next to Manonuga, O perpetuator of the Kuru race, is called Ushna.

sa: संनिहत्य बलादेन विजयस्ते भविष्यति॥ बलात् संस्तम्भयस्वैनं यत्रैषा भिद्यते चमूः।
en: Slay him by putting forth your prowess, and victory will be yours. Check him through your prowess even there where he is penetrating our ranks.

sa: निःश्वासः पवनश्चापि तेजोऽग्निश्च तवाच्युत। बाहवस्ते दिशः सर्वाः कुक्षिश्चापि महार्णवः॥
en: O undeteriorating one, the winds are your breaths, the fire is your splendour, the directions are your arms and the great ocean is your stomach.

sa: केशग्रहं प्रहारांश्च शिरस्येतान् विवर्जयेत्॥ न संहताभ्यां पाणिभ्यां कण्डूयेदात्मनः शिरः।
en: One should never strike another on the heads or seize another by the hair. One should prol join his hand together for scratching his head.

sa: विसृज्य तु सुहृद्वर्ग बुद्ध्या निश्चित्य राघवः। समीपे द्वा:स्थमासीनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having sent away his friends and determined what to do, Rāma, the delight of the Råghus, commanded the warder, who was seated hard by, saying.

sa: उपास्ते त्वां नरव्याघ्र सह कृष्णेन धीमता। तमिमं पुरयानाय समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: With highly intelligent Krishna by his side he bends his head in respect to you. You should give him leave for returning to the city.

sa: न मे राष्ट्रे विधवा ब्रह्मबर्दू ब्राह्मणः कितवो नोत चोरः। अयाज्ययाजी न च पापकर्मा न में भयं विद्यते राक्षसेभ्यः॥
en: In my kingdom there are no widows, no wicked Brahmanas, no Brahmana who had not satisfied his duties, no deceitful person, no thief, no Brahmana who officiates in the sacrifices of those for whom he should never officiate, and no perpetrator of sinful deeds. I do not fear the Rakshasas.

sa: भूयो भूयः समीहन्ते मधूनि भरतर्षभ॥ स्वादनीयानि भूतानां यैर्बालो विप्रकृष्यते।
en: They repeatedly desired, O foremost of Bharata's race, to taste that honey which though sweet to all creatures could, however, attract children only. was not

sa: अप्रियाणि ततोऽन्योन्यमुक्त्वा तौ कुरुसत्तमौ। उदीक्षन्तौ स्थितौ तत्र वृत्रशक्रौ यथाऽऽहवे॥
en: Having addressed each other with unpleasant words, those two heroes of Kuru's race stood, looking angrily upon each other, like Shakra and Vritra in fight."

sa: कर्म चैतदसाधूनां वृजिनानामसाधुवत्। न धर्मोऽस्तीति मन्वानाः शुचीनवहसन्ति ये॥ अश्रद्दधाना धर्मस्य ते नश्यन्ति न संशयः। महादृतिरिवाघ्मातः पापो भवति नित्यदा॥
en: By committing a crime one becomes wicked and dishonest. Those who consider that there is no virtue or those, who laugh at the pure and good, these vicious men undoubtedly find decay in the long run. The wicked person daily grows flatulent, even as the leather bag inflated with wind.

sa: संचिनोत्यशुभं कर्म कलत्रापेक्षया नरः। एकः क्लेशानवाप्नोति परत्रेह च मानवः॥
en: Man, for the sake of his wife, commits numberless evil deeds, but suffers alone various kinds of misery both in this and the next world.

sa: चिन्तयानः स्वधर्मस्य सूक्ष्मां गतिमथाब्रवीत्। श्रद्दधानेन वै भाव्यं गच्छामि मिथिलामहम्॥
en: Thus meditating upon the fine way of virtue, he said, I should, indeed, respectfully agree to her speech; and, therefore, go at once to Mithila.

sa: तथा सर्वं स नगरं प्रसाद्य भरतर्षभ। वासुदेवं महात्मानमभ्यगच्छत् कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Having pleased everybody, including the citizens, in this way, Yudhishthira, O foremost of Bharata's race, approached with joined hands the presence of the great Vasudeva.

sa: यमत्वं कुर्वतस्तस्य देवदेवस्यधीमतः। न तत्र म्रियते कश्चिज्जायते वा तथाप्युत॥
en: O undeteriorating one, when the god of gods began to perform the duties of Yama, there was no death (on earth), but births were numerous.

sa: स पन्थानमथासाद्य समुद्राभिसरं तदा। आससाद वनं रम्यं दिव्यं पुष्पितपादपम्॥
en: At last coming upon a road leading towards the ocean, he travelled on till the reached a charming and heavenly forest filled with blossoming trees.

sa: तेषां समविभक्तानां क्षितौ देहवतामिव। बभौ धर्मार्थकामानां चतुर्थ इव पार्थिवः॥
en: It appeared as if the three pursuits, Dharma, Artha and Kama, became personified on earth; and with them the king shined as the fourth (pursuit).

sa: पुरा भागीरथीतीरे भीष्मोधर्मभृतां वरः। पित्र्यं व्रतं समास्थाय न्यवसन्मुनिभिः सह॥ शुभे देशे तथा राजन् पुण्ये देवर्षिसेविते। गङ्गाद्वारे महाभाग देवगन्धर्वसेविते॥
en: Formerly that foremost of virtuous men Bhishma, when observing the Pitrya vow, lived on the banks of the Bhagirathi with the Rishis. O king, O highly exalted one, it was a delightful and sacred region, situated on the source of the Ganges and frequented by the celestials and the Gandharvas.

sa: स मन्यमानस्त्वाचार्यो ममायं फाल्गुनो यथा। भीमः करिष्यते पूजामित्युवाच वृकोदरम्॥
en: Thereupon that son of Pandu appeared beautiful like the sun shooting his rays only in an upward direction. Then the Preceptor considering that, like Phalguna.

sa: ततो दूरात् प्रकाशन्तं पाण्डुरं मेरुसंनिभम्। ददृशुस्ते नरश्रेष्ठा विकीर्णं सर्वतोदिशम्॥
en: Those best of men then saw at a distance some white objects of vast proportions which looked like the Meru (mountain) stretching in all directions.

sa: यथा हि किरणा भानोस्तपन्तीह चराचरम्। तथा पार्थभुजोत्सृष्टाः शरास्तप्यन्ति मत्सुतान्॥
en: As the rays of the sun scorch mobile and immobile universe, so will the arrows, shot by the arins of Partha, scorch all my sons.

sa: ब्राह्मणो बहुभोक्तास्मि भुञ्जेऽपरिमितं सदा। भिक्षे वार्ष्णेयपार्थो वामेकां तृप्तिं प्रयच्छतम्॥
en: I am a voracious Brahmana that eats much. o descendants of Vrishni and Pritha, I ask you to gratify me by giving me sufficient foot.”

sa: तपोबलव्ययं कृत्वा सुचिरात् सम्भृतं तदा। माण्डव्येनर्षिणा धर्मो ह्यभिभूतः सनातनः॥
en: The eternal deity of Virtue was stupefied by the Rishi Mandavya with an expenditure of his penances acquired for a long time with great care,

sa: अब पूर्वश्चतुर्वर्गः पितृयाणपथे स्थितः। कर्तव्यमिति यत् कार्यं नाभिमानात् समाचरेत्॥
en: Of these the first four pave the way to the regions of Pitris. Therefore it is the duty of all to act by renouncing Abhimana.

sa: ततो ददर्श स बलिं खरवेषेण संवृतम्। यथाऽऽख्यातं भगवता शून्यागारकृतालयम्॥
en: He succeeded in meeting with Vali, who, as the Creator had said, was living in an empty room, clothed in the form of an ass.

sa: तस्मिन्नध्यासति गुरावासनं परमार्चितम्। ततो वक्ष्यसि यत्त्वां स प्रक्ष्यति द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: When he will sit on the highly honoured seat for the preceptor, you will reply to what best of the twice born will ask you.

sa: तावुभौ समरे शूरौ शरकण्टकिनौ तदा। व्यराजेतां महाराज श्वाविधौ शललैरिव॥
en: With arrows stricking (to their bodies) like prickly thorms, they, O mighty monarch, looked, in (that) engagement, like a couple of porcupines with erect quills.

sa: मुखतः सोऽसृजद् विप्रान् बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियांस्तथा॥ वैश्यांश्चाप्यूस्तो राजशूद्रान् वै पादतस्तथा।
en: From His mouth, O monarch, He created, the Regenerate, from His arms the Kshatriya, from His thighs the Vaishyas and from His legs the Shudras.

sa: तं रथेन नरव्याघ्रः प्रत्यगृह्णाद् धनंजयः। स संनिपातस्तुमुलो बभूव स्थनागयोः॥
en: Thereupon Dhananjaya that foremost of men, received him. (Bhagadatta), opposing him with his car. Then a fierce encounter raged between that car and that elephant.

sa: गालवस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा वैनतेयेन भाषितम्। चतुर्भागावशिष्टं तदाचख्यौ कार्यमस्य हि॥
en: Galava too, hearing those words spoken by the son of Vinata, informed him that a fourth part of the work yet remained to be done.

sa: शोषणं सागरस्येव पर्वतस्येव चालनम्॥ नभसः पतनं चैव शैत्यमग्नेस्तथैव च। अश्रद्धेयमहं मन्ये विनाशं शार्ङ्गधन्वनः॥ न चेह स्थातुमिच्छामि लोके कृष्णविनाकृत्।
en: The death of the holder of Sharnga is as incredible as the drying up of the ocean, the displacement of a mountain, the falling down of the heaven, or the cooling property of fie. Deprived of the company of the Vrishni heroes, I wish not to live in this world.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा प्रारुदत् कृष्णा मुखं प्रच्छाद्य पाणिना। पद्मकोशप्रकाशेन मृदुना मृदुभाषिणी॥
en: Having said this, the mild-speeched Krishna (Draupadi) hid her face with her soft hands which were like the buds of lotus and began to weep.

sa: शरीरस्याविरोधेन प्राणिनां प्राणभृद्वर। इष्यते यशसः प्राप्तिः कीर्तिश्च त्रिदिवे स्थिरा॥
en: O best of those that bear life, creatures do not wish to sacrifice their bodies for renown in this world and everlasting fame in heaven.

sa: अथ भीमस्तु तच्छुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यमपेतभीः। क्रुद्धः प्रोवाच वै द्रोणं रक्तताप्रेक्षणस्त्वरन्॥
en: But you shall never be able (of allowed) to enter into this division of mine." Thereupon the dauntless Bhima, hearing those words of the preceptor.

sa: समं पर्यपतंश्चान्ये कुर्वन्तो महदाकुलम्। तत्र केचिन्नरा भीता व्यलीयन्त महीतले॥
en: Many huddled together, set up a great confusion, some stricken with fear, prostrated themselves on the Earth. The animals of the camp crushed them there.

sa: धेनुर्वत्सस्य गोपस्य स्वामिनस्तस्करस्य च। पयः पिबति यस्तस्या धेनुस्तस्येति निश्चयः॥
en: The cow belongs to the calf, to the cowherd who is her master, and to the thief. Indeed, she is his who drinks her milk.

sa: मरुद्गणाद् भीमसेनं बलवन्तमरिंदमम्। विद्धि त्वं तु नरमृषिमिमं पार्थं धनञ्जयम्॥
en: Bhimasena of great power that chastiser of enemies, is from the Maruts. Know that this Dhananjaya, the son of Pritha, is the ancient Rishi Nara.

sa: कच्चिदुन्मथ्य शिविरं हत्वा सोमकपाण्डवान्। दुर्योधनस्य पदवीं गतौ परमिको रणे॥
en: Or, have they, after despoiling the camp, the Somakas, and the Pandavas, followed, while still fighting, the highly illustrious path in which Duryodhana has gone.

sa: कृतास्त्रं निपुणं युद्धेऽप्रतिमानधनुष्मताम्। न पश्यामि कुरुश्रेष्ठ तेन तप्ये वृकोदर॥
en: As I do not see that foremost of the Kurus, accomplished in arms, skillful in fight and matchless among bowmen, O Vrikodara I am miserable.

sa: यथा च त्वाभिनन्दामि वध्वद्य क्षौमसंवृताम्। तथा भूयोऽभिनन्दिष्ये जातपुत्रां गुणान्विताम्॥
en: O daughter-in-law, as I rejoice to-day on seeing you in red silk, so I shall rejoice when you will give birth to an accomplished son.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा राजशार्दूला हृष्टाः परिघवाहवः। द्रुपदं तु जिघांसन्तः सायुधाः समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Having said this, those best of kings, having arms like the spiked iron maces, took up their weapons and rushed upon Drupada to kill him.

sa: अस्मिन् राजसमावाये देवानामिव संनये। किमयं सदृशं कञ्चित्रपतिं नैव दृष्टवान्॥
en: In this assemblage of monarchs which is like a conclave of the celestials, does he not find a single king who is equal to himself?

sa: सहस्रांशुं ततो विप्रः कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः। वसिष्ठोऽहमिति प्रीत्या स चात्मानं न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Thereupon, the Brahmana (Vasishtha) came with joined hands to the deity of one thousand rays and he then introduced himself by saying, “I am Vasishtha."

sa: तमेवमुक्त्वा राजर्षिः पूरुं राज्यविवर्धनम्। अभिषेकेण संपूज्य आश्रमं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Having thus imprecated Yadu, the royal saint Yayāti honoured Puru, Puru, the enhancer of prosperity of the kingdom, with installation and then retired to woods.

sa: ततो वयममित्रघ्न तस्मिन् प्रतिगते नृपे। पुनरानन्दिनः सर्वे मथुरायां वसामहे॥
en: O slayer of all foes, on the departure of the King (Jarasandha), we were filled with great joy, and we continued to live at Mathura.

sa: इत्येवमादि सुमहत् खड्गे धनुषि चानघ। गदायां शस्त्रकुशलो मण्डलानि ह्यदर्शयत्॥
en: O sinless one, in this manner he (Arjuna), walking round the arena, displayed his profound skill in the use of the sword, bow and club.

sa: पुलस्त्यस्तु वधात् तेषां रक्षसां भरतर्षभ। उवाचेदं वचः पार्थ पराशरमरिंदमम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O Partha, seeing that many Rakshasas had been already killed, Pulastya spoke thus to that chastiser of foes, Parashara,

sa: दैवोपभोग्यं दिव्यं त्वामाकाशे स्फाटिकं महत्। आकाशगं त्वां महत्तं विमानमुपपत्स्यते॥
en: I shall give you an excellent and great crystal car, which the celestials alone possess and which is capable of carrying you through the sky.

sa: आचख्युः कवयः केचित् संप्रत्याचक्षते परे। आख्यास्यन्ति तथैवान्ये इतिहासमिमं भुवि॥
en: Some bards have already sung this history; and some again are teaching it to others; others will no doubt do the same hereafter on earth.

sa: द्रोण उवाच मन्त्राय समुपानीतैर्धराष्ट्र हितैर्नृप। धर्म्यमर्थ्य यशस्यं च वाच्यमित्यनुशुश्रुम्॥
en: Drona said: O king Dhritarashtra, it has been heard that friends summoned for consultation should always speak what is right, true and conductive of fame.

sa: निवेशायाखिला भूमि कन्याभक्ष्यं चरामि भोः। दरिद्रो दुःखशीलश्च पितृभिः संनियोजितः॥
en: Directed by my ancestors, I'm roaming in poverty and sorrow all over the world for wedding a maiden whom I shall get as a gift.

sa: द्रोण उवाच अस्त्राणि मे समग्राणि ससंहाराणि भार्गव। सप्रयोगरहस्यानि दातुर्महस्यशेषतः॥
en: Drona said: O descendant of Bhrigu, you should give me all your arms and weapons, together with the mysterious knowledge of hurling and recalling them.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दत्तेऽवकाशे पुरुषैर्विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनैः। विवेश रङ्गं विस्तीर्णं कर्णः परपुरंजयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the spectators, with eyes expended with wonder, made way for that subjugator of hostile cities; Karna, he entered the spacious arena.

sa: दधार भगवान्कण्ठे मन्त्रमूर्तिर्महेश्वरः। तदा प्रभृति देवस्तु नीलकण्ठ इति श्रुतिः॥
en: The great Deity Maheshvara of Mantraform held it in his throat and it is said that from the very day he was called Nilkantha (bluethroated).

sa: यथावदर्चयित्वाथ पृष्ट्वा चानामयं तदा। उवाच स्मयमानेव किं कार्य क्रियतामिति॥
en: Having thus honoured him in due form and enquired about his health and peace, the maiden most respectfully asked the king, "What should be done?”

sa: अनिशं दिव्यवादित्रैर्नृत्यगीतैश्च सा सभा। अशून्या रुचिरा भाति गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः॥
en: That assembly-hall filled with the notes of instrumental and vocal music and with the sounds of various Gandharvas and Apsaras is extremely charming and delicious.

sa: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रभावः पुरुषर्षभ। स्त्रीपूर्वः पौरुषं लेभे।। यच्चान्यदपि दुर्लभम्।।२४
en: O foremost of men, such is the power of the horse-sacrifice, that the king Ila, though converted into a female, regained manhood by virtue thereof.

sa: श्रूयतां मम विज्ञाप्यं कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन। यन्मयोक्तं महाबाहो तव शासनजं विभो॥
en: "O you having long arms, O you the enhancer of Kausalya's joy-I have communicated your orders—I shall relate shortly everything regarding that; do you hear.

sa: स तानपि महेष्वासान् विजिग्ये भरतर्षभ। तैरेव सहितः सर्वैः प्राग्ज्योतिषमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: But O best of the Bharata race, those great bowmen were all defeated by Arjuna. With them all, he then attacked the kingdom of Pragjyotisha.

sa: ततः शरशतैः पार्थं पाञ्चालः शीघ्रमार्दयत्। पार्थस्तु शरवर्षेण छाद्यमानो महारथः॥ वेगं चक्रे महावेगो धनुामवमृज्य च। ततः सत्यजितश्चापं छित्त्वा राजानमभ्ययात्॥
en: Thereupon the Panchala (Satyajit) covered Partha with one hundred arrows. That great car-warrior Arjuna rubbed his bow-string in order to increase the force and velocity of his arrows. Then covering the enemy with a shower of arrows, he cut off the bow of Satyajit and rushed upon the king (Drupada).

sa: स सोममति कान्तत्वादादित्यमति तेजसा। बभूव नृपतिः श्रीमान् सुहृदां दुर्हदामपि।॥
en: Blessed with good fortune, the king (Samvarana) excelled Soma (moon) in soothing the hearts of friends and Surya (sun) scorching the hearts of the enemies.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्द आसीत् पाञ्चालके बले। जिघृक्षति महासिंहो गजानामिव यूथपम्॥
en: Thereupon arose a great uproar among the Panchala-host like the roar of a great lion when springing on the leader of a heard of elephants.

sa: अथ काशिपतेर्भीष्मः कन्यास्तिस्रोऽप्सरोपमाः। शुश्राव सहिता राजन् वृण्वाना वै स्वयंवरम्॥
en: O king, he heard that three daughters of the king of Kashi, all equal to the Apsaras in beauty, would be married at a Sayamvara.

sa: अथ पिष्टोदकेनैनं लोभयन्ति कुमारकाः। पीत्वा पिष्टरसं बालः क्षीरं पीतं मयापि च॥ ननर्वोत्थाय कौरव्य हृष्टो बाल्याद् विमोहितः। तं दृष्ट्वा नृत्यमानं तु बालैः परिवृतं सुतम्॥ हास्यतामुपसम्प्राप्तं कश्मलं तत्र मेऽभवत्। द्रोणं धिगस्त्वधनिनं यो धनं नाधिगच्छति॥
en: Through I roved all over the country, yet I could not obtain a milch-cow and I returned unsuccessful. Thereupon some boys tempted him with Pistaudaka (water mixed with powdered rice). The child, drinking the Pistaudaka cried out, "O I have drunk milk.” O descendant of Kuru, he began to dance in joy, being thus decided by his childish ignorance. Seeing him dance with joy amidst his playmates who were smiling at his simplicity, I was exceedingly touched. “Fie to the poor Drona, who does not try to earn wealth!

sa: निघ्नंश्चरति वार्ष्णेयः कालवत् तत्र भारत। क्षिप्तं क्षिप्तं पुनश्चक्रं कृष्णस्यामित्रघातिनः॥
en: The discus, being hurled from the hands of Krishna, the slayer of foes killed innumerable creatures, and then it came back again to his hands.

sa: पुरोहितः सोमकानां मन्त्रविद् ब्राह्मणः शुचिः। परिस्तीर्य जुहावग्निमाज्येन विधिवत् तदा॥
en: The priest of the lunar race, that holy Brahmana learned in the Mantras, kindling the sacrificial fire in all due forms poured libations of ghee.

sa: ऐलवंश्याश्च ये राजंस्तथैवेक्ष्वाकवो नृपाः। तानि चैकशतं विद्धि कुलानि भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O king, O best of the Bharata race the monarchs (the descendants) of Aila and those of Ikshaku became divided into one hundred separate dynasties.

sa: इत्युक्तो धर्मराजेन भीमसेनो महाबलः। आदाय कुन्तीं भ्रातूंश्च जगामाशु महाबलः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the king of virtue (Yudhisthira), the greatly strong Bhimasena took his brothers and Kunti (on his body) and walked on.

sa: विस्फुरन्तः स्वसन्तश्च वेष्टयन्तः परस्परम्। पुच्छैः शिरोभिश्च भृशं चित्रभानु प्रपेदिरे॥
en: Breathing hard, swelling to enormous sizes, intwining one another with their heads and tails, they came in large numbers and fell into the blazing fire.

sa: तस्मादितः सुरैः सार्धं गन्तुमहर्हसि वासव॥ दिष्टं चाप्यनुपश्यैतत् खाण्डवस्य विनाशनम्।
en: O Vasava, therefore, you should go away from this place with all the celestial. The destruction of the Khandava (forest) has been ordained by fate."

sa: दण्डधारणमुग्रत्वं प्रजानां परिपालनम्। तदिदं क्षत्रियस्यासीत्कर्म वै शृणु मे रुरो॥
en: To be stern, to hold a rod (for punishable), to rule the subjects, are the natural duties of the Kshatriya. Listen to ine, O Ruru.

sa: चरतो मृगयां तस्य क्षुत्पिपासासमन्वितः। ममार राज्ञः कौन्तेय गिरावप्रतिमो हयः॥
en: When thus hunting, the horse of that king of the Kuru race was overcome with hunger and thirst and he (horse) died on the mountains.

sa: विद्याबलं पन्नगेन्द्र पश्य मेऽद्य वनस्पतौ। अहं संजीवयाम्येनं पश्यतस्ते भुजंगम॥
en: "O king of snakes, behold my power of learning in this lord of the forest. O snake, I shall revive it in your very presence.”

sa: उद्दीपितं येन वैरं भूतान्तकरणं महत्। पौलस्त्या भ्रातरश्चास्य जज्ञिरे मनुजेष्विह॥
en: It was he who fanned the fire of hostility, the great fire of destruction. The sons of Pulastya became on earth the brothers of Duryodhana.

sa: कच्चिच्चायव्यये युक्ताः सर्वे गणकलेखकाः। अनुतिष्ठन्ति पूर्वाह्ने नित्यमायं व्ययं तव॥
en: Do you accountants and clerks employ in looking after your income and expenditure always inform you in the forenoon all about your income and expenditure?

sa: असुखानामनाथानां तिर्यग्योनिषु वर्तताम्। स एव राजा सर्वेषां भूतानामभवत् पिता॥
en: That king became a father of those that were miserable, of those that had not protectors, nay even of birds and beasts and all creatures.

sa: तांस्त्वपूर्वेण वेषेण दृष्ट्वा स नृपसत्तमः। उपतस्थे जरासंधो विस्मिताश्चाभवत् तदा॥
en: Seeing the strange attire (of his guests), that best of kings, Jarasandha, be came, very much astonished, but he waited upon them with all respect.

sa: स कदाचिन्मृगं विध्वा बाणेनानतपर्वणा। पृष्ठतो धनुरादाय ससार गहने वने॥
en: One day, having pierced a deer with an arrow, he slang his bow on his back and following it, he entered into a deep forest.

sa: ततः सौभद्रमासाद्य महर्षेस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्। विगाह्य सहसा शूरः स्नानं चक्रे परंतपः॥
en: Then coming to that excellent Tirtha Subhadra, named after a great Rishi, that hero, that chastiser of foes, plunged into it to take a bath.

sa: तेषां मध्ये महाबुद्धिः कृष्णो वचनमब्रवीत्। वक्तुं नायाति राजेन्द्र एतयोर्नियमस्थयोः॥
en: Amongst them the greatly intelligent Krishna thus spoke to him, “O king of kings, these two are observing a vow. They will not therefore speak.

sa: जातं वृद्धं च धर्मेण सुदीर्घेणायुधान्वितम्। चत्वारोऽपि ततो वर्णा बभूवुर्ब्राह्मणोत्तराः॥
en: The new generation, blessed with long life, began to thrive in virtue and thus were again established the four castes having Brahmanas at their head.

sa: श्रूयते हि पुरावृत्तं वासवे सुमहात्मनि। ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रो हयमेधेन पावितः॥
en: It is said in this Purānas, that Purandara, sullied by the sin consequent upon slaying a Brāhmaṇa, was again purified by celebrating a horse sacrifice.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतस्थस्य तस्य दिव्येन हेतुना। साक्षाद् धर्मादयं पुत्रस्तत्र जातो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: He observed there the of Brahmacharya, but for some incrutable purpose of the celestials, this his eldest son, Yudhisthira, was born, begotten by Dharma himself.

sa: तदिदं चैवमस्माकं भयं पन्नगसत्तमाः। दैवमेवाश्रयामोऽत्र शृणुध्वं च वचो मम॥
en: O best of the snakes, the root of our terror is Fate and therefore, Fate alone must be our refuge. Listen to what I say.

sa: तथा काशिषु सुह्येषु पुण्ड्रेषु च नरर्षभ। स्वबाहुबलवीर्येण कुरूणामकरोद् यशः॥
en: O best of men, he then conquered Kashi, Sumha and Pundra; and by the strength of his prowess he spread the fame of the Kurus.

sa: मद्वाक्यसमकालं तु शिरोऽस्य विनिपात्यताम्। एकैकशो नियोक्ष्यामि तथा कुरुत पुत्रकाः।७०॥
en: As soon as I give the order, cut off the bird's head. O sons, I shall give each of you a turn one after another.

sa: व्याहरत्स्वृषिपुत्रेषु मा स्म किंचिद्वचो वद। अस्मद्विधेषु सिद्धेषु ब्रह्मवित्सु तपस्विषु॥
en: Don't speak with the sons of the Rishis like ourselves, who are deep in asceticism, who have knowledge of truth and who have attained Success.

sa: आयुषा विप्रकृष्टेन यदा नः खेद आविशत्। तदास्माभिर्वधस्तात क्षत्रियैरीप्सितः स्वयम्॥
en: O child, when we grew tried with our long life, then it was that we desired our own death at the hands of the Kshatriyas.

sa: वयमग्निं समाविश्य लोकानाप्स्याम शोभनान्। अथास्मान् न दहेदग्निरायास्त्वं पुनरेव नः॥
en: Let us obtain the higher regions by entering the fire. If the fire does not consume us, you can then come back and obtain us.

sa: तत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्रा विविशुः सपरिच्छदाः। पुरोचनस्य वचनात् कैलासमिव गुह्यकाः॥
en: Thereupon those best of men, attired in (costly) garments, entered that house at the request of Purochana, as Guhyakas enter (those) in the Kailasa (mountain).

sa: स तेषु रुधिराम्भ:सुह्रदेषु क्रोधमूर्छितः। पितॄन् संतर्पयामास रुधिरेणेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard, that being senseless with anger, he offered oblations to the manes of his ancestors, standing in the bloody water of these lakes.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् गिरिश्रेष्ठे देवगन्धर्वसेविते। जग्राह विधिवत् पाणिं तपत्याः स नरर्षभः॥
en: That best of kings accepted the hands of Tapati in due form on the breast of that mountain frequented by the celestials and the Gandharvas.

sa: अद्य त्वां भगिनी रक्षः कृष्यमाणं मयासकृत्। द्रक्ष्यत्यद्रिप्रतीकाशं सिंहेनेव महाद्विपम्॥
en: O Rakshasas, your sister will see today that I shall drag you, huge though your are like a mountain, as a lion drags an elephant.

sa: चिरायमाणे दूते तु राजा क्रोधसमन्वितः। अर्दयामास तद्रक्षः शरवृष्ट्या समन्ततः॥
en: On the other hand finding the delay of his return the king Māndhāta, enraged, began to assail the Raksasa Lavaņa with arrows from all sides.

sa: पततो वैनतेयस्य गतिमन्ये यथा खगाः। विनाशमुपयास्यन्ति ये चास्य परिपन्थिनः॥
en: As other birds, can never equal the speed of Vainata's son (Garuda). All those that will stand in his way will meet with certain destruction.

sa: स राजा रतिसक्तत्वादुत्तमस्त्रीगुणैर्हतः। संवत्सरानृतून् मासान् बुबुधे न बहून् गतान्॥
en: The king was so much sunk in the beauty of his wife, that months, seasons and years rolled away without his being conscious of them.

sa: अकीर्तिनिन्द्यते देवैः कीर्तिलॊकेषु पूज्यते॥ कीर्त्यर्थं तु समारम्भः सर्वेषां सुमहात्मनाम्।
en: Even the celestials speak ill of bad name whereas fame is adored in all the regions. Therefore the high-souled exert their best to acquire reputations.

sa: सुपर्ण उवाच न मे सर्वाणि भूतानि बिभियुर्देहदर्शनात्। भीमरूपात्समुद्विग्नास्तस्मात्तेजस्तु संहरे॥
en: Garuda said: No one need be afraid of seeing my body. As you are also very much frightened at its sight, I shall diminish it.

sa: श्रुत्वा शकुनिना द्यूते निकृत्या निर्जितांश्च तान्। क्रुद्धस्यानुप्रशमनं हरेश्चैव किरीटिना॥
en: Having heard that the Pandavas had been defeated at an unjust game of dice by Shakuni, the arrival of Krishna and Arjuna allaying Krishna's anger.

sa: इतिहासमिमं पुण्यमशेषतः श्रावयिष्यन्ति ये नराः श्रोष्यन्ति वा नियतात्मानो विमत्सरा मैत्रा वेदपरास्तेऽपि स्वर्गजित: पुण्यलोका भवन्ति सततं देवब्राह्मणमनुष्याणां मान्याः सम्पूज्याश्च॥
en: Those Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas and all those men who will recite or listen to this holy history with attention and reverence, will conquer the heaven and attain to the abode of the blessed. They will be always respected and adored by the celestials, Brahmanas and all other men.

sa: तत्र गङ्गाजले रम्ये विविक्ते क्रीडयन् स्त्रियः। ईर्युगन्धर्वराजो वै जलक्रीडामुपागतः॥
en: He heard the noise (of the footsteps of the Pandavas) approaching the river. The greatly strong (Gandharva) was inflamed with wrath by (hearing) the noise.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो द्रोणाभ्यनुज्ञातः पार्थः परपुरंजयः। भ्रातृभिस्त्वरयाऽऽश्लिष्टो रणायोपजगाम तम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The subduer of hostile cities, Partha, was embraced by his brothers and with the permission of Drona he advanced for the combat.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दुर्योधन ममाप्येतद्धदि सम्परिवर्तते। अभिप्रायस्य पापत्वान्नैवं तु विवृणोम्यहम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said : O Duryodhana, this is the very thought that exists in my mind, but from its sinfulness, I could not give it out.

sa: यः स कुम्भो रघुश्रेष्ठ तेजःपूर्णो महात्मनोः। तस्मिंस्तेजोमयौ विप्रौ संभूतावृषिसत्तमौ॥
en: O foremost of Raghus, there sprang up two foremost Brahmin saints from the vital energy discharged by the high-souled Mitra and Varuņa into the pot.

sa: यदा क्षोभं नोपयाति नार्तिमन्यतरस्तयोः। ततः स्त्रियस्ता भूतं च सर्वमन्तरधीयत॥
en: When all this did not produce any impression on any of the two (Rishis), then the women and all the other apparitions vanished (into space).

sa: कार्तवीर्यवधो यत्र हैहयानां च वर्ण्यते। प्रभासतीर्थे पांडूनां वृष्णिभिश्च समागमः॥
en: In which is described the death of Kartavirya and Haihayas, then the meeting of the Pandavas and the Vrishnis at the holy pilgrimage of Prabhasa;

sa: जन्तूपाख्यानमत्रैव यत्र पुत्रेण सोमकः। पुत्रार्थमयजदाजा लेभे पुत्रशतं च सः॥
en: Then it tells the story of prince Jantu and how king Somaka, by offering up his only son Jantu in sacrifice, got one hundred others.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अङ्गारपर्णस्तच्छ्रुत्वा क्रुद्ध आनप्य कार्मुकम्। मुमोच बाणान् निशितानहीनाशीविषानिव॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing this, Angarparna became very angry and drawing his bow he shot at them his arrows which were like the poisonous snakes.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण प्रत्युवाच महानृषिः।। आसन्कृतयुगे राम ब्राह्मभूते पुरायुगे। अपार्थिवाः प्रजाः सर्वाःसुराणां तु शतक्रतुः।। ताः प्रजा देवदेवेशं राजार्थं समुपाद्रवन्। सुराणां स्थापितो राजा त्वया देव शतक्रतुः।। प्रयच्छास्मासु लोकेश पार्थिवं नरपुंगवम्। यस्मै पूजां प्रयुञ्जाना धूतपापाश्चरेमहि।।
en: Hearing the words of Rāma, the great saint Agastya replied saying:-0 Rāma, O son of Dasaratha, at the beginning of the golden age, people had no king; but Väsava was the ruler of the celestials. Therefore to obtain a king, men approached Brahmā, the god of gods and said, O deity you have placed Indra as ruler over the celestials; therefore, O lord of creatures, do you also confer upon us a king who shall be foremost among men; by worshipping him we shall be freed from all sins.

sa: आकारेणैव तं ज्ञात्वा पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। रहः समुपविश्यैकस्तत: पप्रच्छ मातरम्॥
en: The son of Pandu Yudhisthira learnt the affair by the appearance of Bhima and sitting by his mother, he spoke thus to her in private.

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच सतामपि कुले जाताः कर्मणा वत दुर्गतिम्। प्राप्नुवन्त्यकृतात्मानः कामजालविमोहिताः॥
en: Pandu said: The wicked men, though born in virtuous families, being illuded with passions, become overwhelmed with misery as the fruit of their own acts.

sa: तप्यमानं तपो घोरं तं ददर्श पितामहः। संशुष्कमांसत्वक्स्नायुं जटाचीरधरं मुनिम्॥
en: The Grandsire saw him with knotted hair, clad in rags, his flesh, skin and sinews dried up owing to the austere penances he was practising.

sa: स्वर्गपर्व ततो ज्ञेयं दिव्यं यत्तदमानुषम्। प्राप्तं दैवस्थं स्वर्गान्नेष्टवान्यत्र धर्मराट्॥
en: Know, the Parva that comes next is called Svarga, full of heavenly matters; in which is related how the celestial car came to take Yudhishthira.

sa: सर्वतः परिवायैवं दावमेतं महाप्रभो। कामं सम्प्रज्वलाद्यैव कल्यौ स्वः साह्यकर्मणि॥
en: Therefore, O lord, blaze as much as you like. Surround this large forest with fire. We are quite capable of helping you. Vaishampayana said :

sa: भरतस्तिसृषु स्त्रीषु नव पुत्रानजीजनत्। नाभ्यनन्दत तान् राजा नानुरूपा ममेत्युत॥
en: Bharata begot on his three wives nine sons, but none of them was like his father and Bharata was not satisfied with any of them.

sa: भीमार्जुनावुभौ नेत्रे मनो मन्ये जनार्दनम्। मनश्चक्षुर्विहीनस्य कीदृशं जीवितं भवेत्॥
en: I consider Bhima and Arjuna as my eyes and you Jarasandha as my mind. How shall I able to live without my eyes and mind?

sa: ततः शक्तिं महावेगां स्वर्णवैदूर्यभूषिताम्। द्रोणस्य निधनाकाक्षी चिक्षेप स पराक्रमी॥
en: Then with the desire of killing him, that greatly powerful prince shot at Drona a dart of great force adorned with gold and Vaidurya gems.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षिप्रमेव समार्पयत्। अश्वांश्चास्यावधीद् राजन्नुभौ तौ पाjि सारथी॥
en: The Panchala prince soon wounded his foe with twenty five arrows and then O king, the killed his horses and then his two wheel protectors.

sa: नानाविधान्यनीकानि पुत्राणां तव भारत। अर्जुनो व्यधमत् काले दिवीवाभ्राणि मारुतः॥
en: Then, O Bharata, like wind scattering masses of clouds in the heavens, Arjuna began to scatter the various divisions composing the army of your son.

sa: तस्य शोणितदिग्धाङ्गा शोणास्ते वातरंहसः। आजानेया हया राजन्नविश्रान्ता ध्रुवं ययुः॥
en: O monarch, his horses, of chestnut colour, of excellent breed, of wind-like speed, and of indefatigable energy, assumed a beautiful appearance being bespattered with blood.

sa: स तेनातिप्रहारेण व्यथितो विह्वलनिव। संचचाल रणे कर्णः क्षितिकम्पे यथाऽचलः॥
en: Pained to the extreme in consequence of that deep wound and over-whelmed with a swoon. Karna trembled in battle like a hili during an earth-quake.

sa: देवमाराधयच्छर्वे गृणन् ब्रह्म सनातनम्। भक्तानुकम्पी भगवांस्तस्य चक्रे ततो दयाम्॥
en: Chanting the eternal hymns of the Vedas, he worshipped the God Sarva (Mahadeva). Thereupon that illustrious God, compassionate towards his devotees, became gracious on him.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु सुशर्माणं विद्ध्वा बहुभिरायसैः। व्यधमत् तस्य तत्सैन्यं महाभ्राणि यथाऽनिलः॥
en: Arjuna also having pierced king Susharma with many shafts of iron, began to scatter the latter's host like a tempest scattering mighty masses of clouds.

sa: यावत् संजायते किंचित् सत्त्वं स्थावटजङ्गमम्। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात् तद् विद्धि भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, know whatever entity, movable and immovable comes into existence, it is out of the connection of Kshetra and Kshetrajna.

sa: तेषां तस्य च सम्मर्दो दारुणः समपद्यत। सृजतां शरवर्षाणि प्रसक्तममितौजसाम्॥
en: The clash between these warriors, endued with infinite energy and scattering a shower of arrows on one side and Abhimanyu on the other, became awful.

sa: संग्रामे न जहुर्भीष्मं युध्यमानं किरीटिना॥ ततस्तमेकं बहवः परिवार्य समन्ततः।
en: Did not abandon Bhishma in battle who had been fighting with the diadem-decked Arjuna. Then surrounding the single car-warrior *Bhishma, large numbers of the enemy,

sa: निघ्नन्नमित्रान् सौभद्रः परमास्त्रैः प्रतापवान्। अदर्शयत तेजस्वी दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत॥
en: With his excellent weapons slaying his focs, the highly puissant son of Subhadra, endued with fierce energy, was then scen, O Bharata, on all directions.

sa: भूमिपालसहस्राणां भूमिः पास्यति शोणितम्। कैलासमन्दराभ्यां तु तथा हिमवता विभो॥
en: Great Rishis have said that in such circumstances, the earth drinks the blood of thousands of kings. From the mountains of Kailasa, Mandara and Himalayas.

sa: सा पपात तथा च्छिन्ना संक्रुद्धेन किरीटिना॥ मेघवृन्दपरिभ्रष्टा विच्छिन्नेव शतह्रदा।
en: Then shattered by the wrathful Arjuna decked with a diadem, that lance fell down like forks of lightning torn away from large masses of clouds.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं युयुधिरे वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः। पार्थिवाः सुमहात्मानो नानादेशसमागताः॥
en: Janamejaya said How did those great warriors, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas and the other illustrious kings who assembled from various countries fight?

sa: ततस्तु सशरं चापं सात्वतस्य महात्मनः। क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: Then that high-famed warrior having pierced Kripa with many arrows, cut off the bow and the arrows of the illustrious descendant of the Satvata race,

sa: धनंजयसमं युद्धे त्वां वयं तात संयुगे प्रणिधायानुयास्यामो रक्षन्तः सर्वतोमुखाः॥
en: Secing you penetrate the hostile ranks, we will follow you, O sire, who are equal to Dhananjaya himself in battle, protecting you from all sides.

sa: भीष्मेण पुत्रास्तव दध्मुः शङ्खान् मुदा युक्ता भेरीः संजनिरे भृशम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Bhishma, O king, your son was filled with delight. He ordered conchs to be blown and drums to be beat.

sa: द्रोणस्तु समरे क्रुद्धो भीमं नवभिरायसैः। विव्याध समरश्लाघी मर्माण्युद्दिश्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: The highly powerful Drona, waxing worth, in that battle, O monarch, pierced Bhishma with nine shafts made of iron directing them towards his vital parts.

sa: धनञ्जयो हि नस्तात गर्हयेदेत्य संयुगगत्। क्षिप्रमस्त्रं समादाय द्रोणानीकं विशातय॥
en: Quickly taking up your arms, smite down this array of Drona so that returning from the fight with the Samshaptakas Dhananjaya may not blame us."

sa: उपलभ्य ततः सामवस्थाप्य च वाहिनीम्। युगपत् पाण्डुपुत्राय चिक्षिपुः कङ्कपत्रिणः॥
en: However, regaining consciousness and rallying their forces, the Samsaptakas discharged simultaneously, at the son of Pandu, shafts furnished with the feathers of the Kanka bird.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धस्ततो राजन् रणे द्रोणेन पार्थिवः। अपायाद् दुपदो राजन् पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्।॥
en: Thus, O king, wounded sore by Drona, that ruler of men, Drupada, fled from the field of battle, remembering his former enmity (with Bharadvaja's son).

sa: स ददर्श महात्मानं शरतल्पगतं तदा। जन्मशय्यागतं वीरं कार्तिकेयमिव प्रभुम्॥
en: There he saw the illustrious hero lying on his arrowy bed, like the heroic lord Kartikeya lying after his birth on his bed of reeds.

sa: तस्मिन् महाभये घोरे तुमुले लोमहर्षणे। ववृषुः शरवर्षाणि क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः॥
en: In that fierce, dreadful terrifying and hairstirring battle, the Kshatriya in capable of being repressed in battle began to shower a veritable down-pour of arrows.

sa: शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते। महता रथवंशेन वारयामास माधवम्॥
en: Beholding that lance to be baffled, your son, O ruler of men, checked him of Madhu's race, surrounding him with a large number of cars,

sa: शयनस्यानुरूपं मे पाण्डवोपहितं त्वया। यद्यन्यथा प्रपद्येथाः शपेयं त्वामहं रूषा॥
en: O son of Pandu, you have indeed fetched me a pillow becoming my bed. Had you fetched me something else, I would have cursed you

sa: जातकर्माणि सर्वाणि कारयामास पार्थिवः। पुंवद्विधानयुक्तानि शिखण्डीति च तां विदुः॥
en: And that king caused all the rites prescribed for a son during infancy to be performed according to all due ordinances, and named her Shikhandin.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वाकिरन् बाणान् द्रपदस्य सुतोबली! पारावतसवर्णाश्वः स्वयं द्रोणमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, the highly puissant son of Drupada the owner of pigeon-white steeds, scattering arrows (on all direction) himself rushed at Drona.

sa: श्रूयते चैव हृष्टानां पाण्डवानां महास्वनः। हस्तिनश्चैव सुमहान् भीतस्य रुदितध्वनिः॥
en: Even now do we hear the mighty uproar of the enraptured Pandavas, as also the distressful and loud cries of the frightened elephants (of Bhagadatta).

sa: अथैनं सहसा सर्वे समन्तानिशितैः अभ्याकिरन् महाराज जलदा इव पर्वतम्॥
en: And so, suddenly there covered him from all sides, with showers of sharpened shafts, O monarch, like the clouds pouring their contents on the mountain.

sa: अभावं नेह गच्छेयुरुत्सन्नजननाः प्रजाः। आदिदेव नियुक्तोऽस्मि त्वया लोकेषु लोककृत्॥
en: Let not these things with their prowess of propagation weakened, be exterminated. O Creator of the world, you have employed me to be their protector.

sa: तस्य सर्वायसी शक्तिं शल्यः कनकभूषणाम्। चिक्षेप समरे घोरां दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव॥
en: Thereupon, at him (Abhimanyu) Shalya hurled, in battle, his dreadful dart made of all iron, decked with gold and resembling a flashing flame of fire.

sa: नाहमेनं धनुष्पाणिं युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्। मुहूर्तमपि पश्येय प्रहरेयं न चाप्युत॥
en: I will not look for a single moment nor even strike, though appearing before me with his bow in his hand with the desire of

sa: सिंहवद् विनदन्नुच्चैर्धनुर्ध्या विक्षिपन् मुहुः। शरोधान् विसृजन् पार्थोव्यरत् कालवद् रणे॥
en: Then like the Destroyer himself, Pritha's son carried through the field, roaring constantly like a lion, twanging his bow string and shooting myriad's of arrows.

sa: युष्माभिरपि कर्तव्यं वचनं मम नित्यशः। तपसाऽस्मि परिश्रान्तो दृढं नियममास्थितः॥
en: But my words too ought to be always listened to by you. I am weakened by devolution but yet attached to it by firm resolve.

sa: आर्जुनि तु ततस्तूर्णं द्रौणिविव्याध पत्रिणा। शल्योऽथ दशभिश्चैव कृपश्च निशितैस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Drona's son also soon wounded Arjuna's son with many winged arrows; Shalya also pierced him with twelve arrows, Kripa shot at him three sharp arrows.

sa: स हत्वा सर्वकालिङ्गान् सेनामध्ये व्यतिष्ठता नैनमभ्युत्सहन् केचित् तावका भरतर्षभ॥
en: Having killed all the Kalingas, O best of the Bharata race, he stood in the midst of the troops, and none dared to withstand him.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे सत्यसंधे महौजसि। त्वत्सुता: कर्णमस्मार्पुस्ततुकामा इव प्लवम्॥
en: On the fall of that most powerful hero of linerring aim, your sons remembered Karna, like persons desirous of crossing the ocean) remembering a raft.

sa: संघट्टयति सैन्यानि द्रोणस्तु रथिनां वरः। व्यधमच्चापि तान्यस्य धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥
en: Then, as many times did that foremost of car-warriors, Drona rally his troops, so many times did that mighty car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna break and route them.

sa: बृहत: सैन्धवानश्वान् समुत्थाप्याथ सारथिः॥ तस्थौ सात्यकिमासाद्य सम्प्लुतस्तं रथं प्रति।
en: His charioteer jumping upon the car, urged the mighty steeds of the Shindhu breed yoked thereto and stopped reaching the spot where Satyaki was sianding.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरं तावकानां महारथौ। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ पार्षतं प्रत्युपस्थितौ॥
en: Hearing that distressful cry uttered by your troop, Vinda and Anuvinda of the Avanti country, both mighty car-warriors, rushed to cncounter the son of Prishata.

sa: वामे चक्रे वर्तमाना: केऽध्न संजय सुंजयान्। अग्रतोऽग्र्यमनीकेषु केऽभ्यरक्षन् दुरासदम्॥
en: Who were they that placed themselves on his left and attacked the Srinjayas? Who were they that protected the irresistible ranks of his advanced guard?

sa: वसातीयं हतं दृष्ट्वा कुद्धाः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः। परिवनुस्तदा राजस्तव पौत्रं जिघांसवः॥
en: Beholding Vasatiya slain, the foremost of the Kshatriyas all excited with rage, surrounded, O king, your grandson, desirous of taking his life out of him.

sa: दुःशासनश्च बलवान् सह सर्वैः सहोदरैः। भीष्मं समरमध्यस्थं पालयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा॥
en: As also your highly puissant son Dushasana supported by all his uterine brothers, then began to support Bhishma staying in the midst of the troops.

sa: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः। रसवर्ज रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते॥
en: The objects of senses draw from an abstinent person, but not so his passions. But the passions fly from him who has seen the Supreme.

sa: ततः कृष्णश्च पार्थश्च संस्पृश्याम्भः कृताञ्जली। तौ नागावुपतस्थाते नमस्यन्तौ वृषध्वजम्॥
en: Then Krishna and Partha, having touched water and having folded their palms and saluted the god having the bull of his emblem, approached those snakes.

sa: स्वेन सैन्येन महता प्रतपन् शत्रुवाहिनीम्। प्रधक्ष्यति स पञ्चालान् कक्षमग्निगतिर्यथा॥
en: With his own large army affecting the army of his enemies he will consume the Panchalas as the course of fire does the dry grass.

sa: गदाश्च विमलैः पट्टैः पिनद्धाः स्वर्णभूषितैः। पतन्त्यस्तत्र दृश्यन्ते गिरिशृङ्गोपमाः शुभाः॥
en: Maces, covered with shining pierces of cloth and decked with gold were seen to fall on the field like so many beautiful crests of mountains.

sa: क्षिप्रं श्येनाभिपन्नानां वायसानामिव स्वनः। बभूव पाण्डवेयानां भृशं विद्रवतां स्वनः॥
en: Like the cawing of the crows pounced upon by the hawks. A confused noise was heard among the Pandava hosts, as they fled with speed.

sa: यथा प्रज्वलितं वह्नि पतङ्गः समभिद्रवन्। एकतो मृत्युमभ्येति तथाऽहं भीष्ममीयिवान्॥
en: Just as an insect rushing at a blazing fire reaps only death, so llave I reaped the same result having dared a combat with Bhishma.

sa: निपतद्भिस्तथा तैश्च हयसंधैः परस्परम्। शुश्रुवे दारुणः शब्दः सुपर्णपतने यथा॥
en: When those two horse divisions thus clashed against one another (and some fell down), a terrible sound, resembling that of Suparna's swoop was heard there.

sa: सर्वधातुविचित्रश्च शृङ्गवान् नाम पर्वतः। एते वै पर्वता राजन् सिद्धचारणसेविताः॥
en: And Shringavat which is made of all kinds of metals. O king, these are the six mountains ever frequented by the Siddhas and the Charanas.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य पुण्डरीकाक्षमाहवे। असम्भ्रमं रणे भीष्मो विचकर्ष महद् धनुः॥
en: Then beholding in that dreadful battle, Krishna of eyes like lotus petals rush furiously towards him, Bhishma began to stretch his strong and mighty bow.

sa: स निकृत्तं धनुर्दृष्ट्वा खं जवेन समाविशत्। इरावन्तमभिक्रुद्धं मोहयन्निव मायया॥
en: Seeing his bow severed, he speedily mounted on the sky, confounding as it were with his illusive powers Iravat who was greatly excited with rage.

sa: उत्सृज्य रजतप्रख्यान् हयान् पार्थस्य मारिष। वासुदेवस्ततो योगी प्रचस्कन्द महारथात्॥
en: Then, O sire, throwing away the reins of Partha's steeds of Argentine hue, that illustrious Yogin (Krishna) waxing irascible, jumped down from that huge chariot.

sa: देव्युवाच स्वल्पेनैव तु कालेन शत्रूञ्जेष्यसि पाण्डव। नरस्त्वमसि दुर्धर्ष नारायणसहायवान्॥
en: The goddess said O son of Pandu, you will vanquish your enemy in no time. O invincible one. You have Narayana himself to help you.

sa: राष्ट्रनिर्वासनक्लेशं वनवासं च पाण्डव। कृष्णायाश्च परिक्लेशं संस्मरन् पुरुषो भव॥
en: All the objects for which a Kshatriya lady brings forth a son are now come, strength, prowess, heroism and skillfulness in the use of weapon,

sa: सुभद्रे मा शुचः पुत्रं पाञ्चाल्याश्वासयोत्तराम्। गतोऽभिमन्युः प्रथितां गतिं क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः॥
en: 0 Subhadra, bewail not your son; O Panchali, console the sister of Ullara. Abhimany'i, that foremost of Kshatriyas, has atlaired in the most excellent state.

sa: आर्ति परामाविशति मनः शंससि मे हतम्। कुरूणामृषभं वीरमकम्पं पुरुषर्षभम्॥
en: Hearing that the foremost of men, the best of the Kurus, the unwavering hero (Bhishma) is killed, my heart is possessed by great grief. sun

sa: सहस्रमश्वाश्चैकैकं गजाना पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः। अश्वे अश्वे शतं गावो गवां पश्चादजाविकम्॥
en: A thousand horses followed each king and after each horse, came a hundred cows and after the cows came sheep and deer, countless in number.

sa: भित्त्वा चास्य तनुत्राणं शरैणोरस्यताडयत्। ततस्ते तावका वीरा राजपुत्रा महारथाः॥
en: Penetrating his coat of mail, Arjuna's son, pierced him with a shaft on the breast. Thereat the heroic princes of your army all mighty carwarriors.

sa: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ वेगवन्तं महाबलम्। अमुचं समरे बाणं रामाय हृदयच्छिदम्॥
en: Then O foremost among the Bharatas, in that battle, I shot forth an arrow of great strength and speed on Rama that struck his heart.

sa: हा पुत्र मम मन्दायाः कथमेत्यासि संयुगम्। निधनं प्राप्तवांस्तात पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Alas! son of my unfortunate self, why did you go to the battle? Oh son equal in prowess to your father, how could you perish?

sa: वर्जयन् निशितान् बाणान् द्रोणचापिविनिः सृतान्। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयो भोजानीकं व्यशातयत्॥
en: Then avoiding the aim of the whetted shafts shot from Drona's bow, the diadem-decked son of Kunti fell to slaughter the division of the Bhojas.
