sa: नागैरिव महानागा यथावद् गिरिहरे। तेऽपि प्रासैः सुनिशितैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Like huge elephants falling down in mountain caves, slain by their compeers. Those warriors of the Pandava, army also with sharp lances and straight shafts,

sa: अस्त्राणां पात्यमानानां कवचेषु शरीरिणाम्। शब्दः समभवद् राजन् गिरीणामिव भिद्यताम्॥
en: The din produced by the stroke of weapons against the armours of the combatants, resembled, O king, the sound produced by the rending of mountains.

sa: सर्वे ते व्यथिताः सैन्यास्त्वदीया भरतर्षभ। श्रुत्वा महाबलस्योग्रां प्रतिज्ञा सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: And having heard of the fierce vow of the mighty Savyasachin, all your troops. O foremost of the Bharatas, became preyed upon by anxious thought.

sa: ततोऽहं तान् नृपान् सर्वानाहूय समरे स्थितान्। रथमारोपयांचने कन्यास्ता भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then did I, challenging all those rulers of the earth to fight, carried by force, the girls to my chariot, O best of the Bharatas.

sa: शङ्खदुन्दुभिघोषैश्च वारणानां च बृंहितैः। नेमिघोषै रथानां च दीर्यतीव वसुंधराः॥
en: With the sounds of conchs and drums, the roaring of elephants and thc clatter of the carwheels, the earth seemed to be rent into two.

sa: अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं तव सैन्यान्यभीषयत्। तमुद्वीक्ष्य गदाहस्तं ततस्ते गजसादिनः॥
en: Speedily jumped down from his car and struck terror into the hearts of your troops. Then those elephant-warriors, beholding him stand with mace in hand,

sa: यस्तु गोप्ता महेष्वासस्तस्य पापस्य दुर्मतेः। तमेव प्रथमं द्रोणमभियास्यामि केशव॥
en: That, О Keshava, at the very first instance, I shall proceed against that Drona, that fierce bowman who had undertaken to protect the sinful Jayadratha.

sa: पक्षकोटिप्रपक्षेषु पक्षान्तेषु च वारणा:॥ जग्मुः परिवृता राजंश्चलन्त इव पर्वताः।
en: On the joints of the wings, on the wings and the extremities of the wings, stood innumerable elephants loO king like so many blazing mountains.

sa: एवपुक्तस्त्ववाक्शीर्षो विमनाः स सुयोधनः। श्रुत्वा तं समयं तस्य ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Thus spoken to, Suyodhana hang down his head and became depressed at heart. And ascertaining Jayadratha to be greatly terrified, he began to meditate (silently).

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्ते ततो द्रोर्ण जयेत्यूचुनराधिपाः। सिंहनादेन महता हर्षयन्तस्तवात्मजम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When Duryodhana had finished his address, the kings, imparting great delight to your sons by their loud defiant shouts, exclaimed Victory to Drona.

sa: स भिन्नहृदयो राजा भगदत्तः किरीटिना॥ शरासनं शरांश्चैव गतासुः प्रमुमोच ह। शिरसस्तस्य विभ्रष्टं पपात च वरांशुकम्। नालताडनविभ्रष्टं पलाशं नलिनादिव॥
en: His bosom being torn open the diademdecked Arjuna. King Bhagadatta lost the grasp of his bow and arrows, being deprived of vitality. The precious cloth that had constituted his turban now fell off from his head like a petal falling off from a lotus when its stem is struck violently.

sa: ततो धनंजयो वीरो विनिमंस्तव सैनिकान्। आससाद रणे भीष्मं पुत्रप्रेप्सुरमर्षणः॥
en: Thereupon that heroic Dhananjaya, highly enraged, desirous of rescuing his son, rushed to the spot where the latter was, slaying your troops as he came.

sa: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वाभिविद्रुतम्। महता शरवर्षेण सौभद्रं पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Thereupon Bhishma the son of Shantanu beholding the troops thus routed by the son of Subhadra, choked the latter with a mighty shower of arrows.

sa: नालमेष क्षयं कर्तुं परसैन्यस्य मारिष। आर्जवेनैव युद्धेन वीर वर्षशतैरपि॥
en: O sire, this hero, however, is incapable of destroying in a fair fight the troops of our army if he tries for one hundred years.

sa: रथिनश्च स्थै राजन् कर्णिनालीकसायकैः। निहत्य समरे वीरान् सिंहनादान् विनेदिरे॥
en: Car-warriors riding on their cars, O king, having slain many heroes with Karnis (barbed arrows) Nalikas (fire-arms) and shafts to began to vociferate their war-cries.

sa: स्यालौ तव महात्मानौ राजानौ वृषकाचलौ। भृशं विजनतुः पार्थमिन्द्रं वृत्रबलाविव॥
en: Then those two kings, your brothers-in-law, viz., Vrishaka and Achala of illustrious souls, began to wound Partha sorely, like Bala or Vritra wounding Indra himself.

sa: तन्न देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरोरगराक्षसाः। उत्सहन्तेऽन्यथाकर्तुं कुत एव नराधिपाः॥
en: Even the Gandharavas, the Asuras the reptiles and the Rakshasas, cannot dare baffle a vow of Arjuna, what to speak of the rulers of men?

sa: तत्र ते कारणं राजन् प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे। नारदस्तमृषिर्वेद भीष्मद्रोणौ च पाण्डव॥
en: O king, you are without malice. I shall therefore tell you of the means. The Rishi Narada as well as Bhishma and Drona know it.

sa: ततः प्रयाते सहसा भारद्वाजे महारथे॥ आर्तनादेन घोरेण वसुधा समकम्पत।
en: Thereafter when the mighty car-warrior, the son of Bharadvaja, flew suddenly to the fight, the earth began to shake with the sound of terrible wails.

sa: मृदुपूर्वं शठोदकं कर्णमाभाष्य कौरवः। कस्मादन्नानि पानानि वासांसि शयनानि च॥
en: In an humble voice but with evil intention concealed in his heart and looking at Karna. 'For what reason the eatables, drinks, garment and beds.

sa: ततो रथाभ्यां प्रस्कन्ध भ्रातरौ क्षत्रियर्षभौ। गदापाणी सुसंरब्धौ समभ्यद्रवतां रथान्॥
en: Then descending from their chariots, those two brothers, the foremost of Kshatriyas, worked up with anger, with mace in hands, rushed towards (the enemy's) cars.

sa: को जिजीविषुरासादेद् धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम्। पञ्चैतान् पाण्डवेयांस्तु द्रौपद्याः कीर्तिवर्धनान्॥
en: What man valuing his life can approach the descendant of Prishata Dhrishtadyumna also the five sons of the Pandavas who have added to Draupadi's glory.

sa: विदुरोऽहं महाप्राज्ञ सम्प्राप्तस्तव शासनात्। यदि किंचन कर्तव्यमयमस्मि प्रशाधि माम्॥
en: O you of great wisdom, I am Vidura, come here by your command, if there is anything to be done, here I am; command me.

sa: पतिपुत्रवधादेतत् परमं दुःखमब्रवीत्। दारिद्र्यमिति यत् प्रोक्तं पर्यायमरणं हि तत्॥
en: He said that this as a greater troubles than the death of one's husband and sons; what is called poverty is another form of death.

sa: द्युमत्सेन उवाच अतितीव्रोऽयमारम्भस्त्वयाऽऽरब्धो नृपात्मजे। तिसृणां वससीतनां हि स्थानं परमदुश्चरम्॥
en: Dyumatsena said : Princess, the vow you have taken is very difficult to observe, for, it is extremely hard to fast continuously for three nights.

sa: ततः किलकिलाभूतमनीकं पाण्डवस्य ह। आज्ञापिते तदा योगे समहष्यन्त सैनिकाः॥
en: Then was there a din in the army of the Pandavas, and on the order of the arraying troops being given the soldiers became cheerful.

sa: तं वेणीकृतकेशान्तं भीमधन्वानमर्जुनम्। कन्यापरिवृतं दृष्ट्वा भीम सीदति मे मनः॥
en: O Bhima, seeing that mighty wielder of bow, Arjuna, with braids ending in ugly curls and surrounded by damsels, my heart is stricken with distress.

sa: अश्यं हरिसहस्रेण युक्तं जैत्रं रथोत्तमम्। देवासुरेषु युद्धेषु मनसैव नियच्छति॥
en: He drives, by his will force alone, the excellent car accustomed to victory in wars between the gods and Asuras, yoked to a thousand steeds.

sa: वेद कृष्णस्य माहात्म्यं वेदास्य दृढभक्तिताम्। अत्याज्ययस्य जानामि प्राणैस्तुल्यं धनंजयम्॥
en: I know the noble-mindedness of Krishna and I know his firm devotion and I know that Dhananjaya is inseparable from him even as life itself.

sa: तान् वेपमानान् वित्रस्तान् बीजमात्रावशेषितान्। मृगान् दृष्ट्वा सुदुःखार्तो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Seeing those deer which remained like seed after the rest had been destroyed, trembling and afflicted with fear, Dharamaraja (Yudhishthira) was greatly affected with grief.

sa: कुर्वन् रथान् विपुरुषान् विसारथिहयध्वजान्। आरुजन् पुरुषव्याघ्रो रथिनः सादिनस्तथा॥ गङ्गावेग इवानूपांस्तीरजान् विविधान् दुमान्। प्रभक्षयति रणे सेनां पुत्राणां मम संजय॥
en: Rendering the chariots devoid of men, drivers, horse and banners and giving trouble to the warriors fighting from cars and elephants, the tiger among men, like the force of the currents of the Ganga uprooting various sorts of trees, will vanquish in battle the army of my sons, O Sanjaya.

sa: प्रत्यक्षदर्शी सर्वस्य नारदोऽयं महातपाः। महात्म्यस्य तदा विष्णोः सोऽयं चक्रगदाधर॥
en: This Narada, of great asceticism, saw all this with his own eyes and this Krishna held the mice and discus of that great souled Vishnu.

sa: धर्मार्थो सम्प्रधाव यदि सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्। प्रमुञ्चैमान् मृत्युपाशात् क्षत्रियान् पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: If I am speaking the truth, keeping in fact virtue and morality, then liberate these Kshatriyas from the shackles of death, O foremost among men.

sa: भविता विग्रहः सोऽहं तुमुलो लोमहर्षणः। तस्मात् सांग्रामिकं सर्वं कारयध्वमतन्द्रिताः॥
en: Therefore will there be a fierce war which will make one's hair stand on end; therefore do you make all preparations of war very carefully.

sa: एतद् विधाय वै सर्वं देवाहमतिमानुषम्। आचख्यौ धृतराष्ट्राय राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा।॥
en: Having done all this, which could be done only by gods and men of superhuman qualifications, king Duryodhana informed Dhritarashtra of what he had done.

sa: त्रयस्त्रिंशदिमे देवा येषां लोका मनीषिभिः। गम्यन्ते नियमैः श्रेष्ठैर्दानैर्वा विधिपूर्वकैः॥
en: The number of these gods is thirty-three. To their region go wise men after having observed excellent vows or bestowed gifts according to the ordiance.

sa: समृद्धा गुणत: केचिद् भवन्ति धनतोऽपरे। धनवृद्धान् गुणै_नान् धृतराष्ट्र विवर्जय॥
en: Some become eminent thought their good qualities; others through their wealth. Avoid, O Dhritarashtra, those who are superior in wealth, but devoid of good qualities.

sa: रथानां च गजानां च वाजिनां च ससादिनाम्। सहस्रशतसङ्घाता शूराणामुग्रधन्विनाम्॥
en: And hundreds of thousand of chariots, elephants, horses, horsemen and brave and powerful bowmen were over thrown by him before the very presence of Virata.

sa: असौ मन्ये न जानीते समयप्रतिपालनम्। कृतोपकारं मा नूनमवमन्याल्पया धिया।॥
en: I consider that, through scantiness of intellect, he does not care to fulfill his promise, disregarding me who have done him (such) a good turn.

sa: तैरेवोपार्जितां भूमि भोक्ष्यसे च परंतप। यदि सम्पत्स्यसे पुत्रैः सहामात्यैर्नराधिप॥
en: Territories acquired by them will you enjoy, O chastiser of enemies if you are allied to your sons, kinsmen and counselors, O lord of men.

sa: अथ शुश्राव नहुषः शक्राणी शरणं गताम्। बृहस्पतेरङ्गिरसचक्रोध स नृपस्तदा॥
en: Nahusha heard that the queen of Indra had placed herself under the protection of Brihaspati the son of Angirasa and the king became very angry.

sa: अथापि घटतेऽस्माकमर्थे वानरपुङ्गवः। तमादायैव काकुत्स्थ त्वरावान् भव मा चिरम्॥
en: But if that foremost of monkeys be devoted to our cause, then O descendant of Kakustha, bring him hither. Go soon and make no delay.”

sa: संधाय धार्तराष्ट्रेण पार्थानां विप्रिये रतः। योद्धमाशंसते नित्यं फाल्गुनेन महात्मना॥
en: Having contracted a friendship with the son of Dhritarashtra, he became hostile to the Parthas and was always desirous of fighting with the high-souled Falguna.

sa: द्रुपदश्च महातेजा बलेन महता वृतः। त्यक्तात्मा पाण्डवार्थाय योत्स्यमानो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Drupada too of great prowess and surrounded by a large force has sacrificed his interests for the Pandava's cause and desirous of fighting is present.

sa: अहं हि वचनं त्वत्तः शुश्रूषुरपरापरम्। किंचित् किंचित् प्रतिवदंस्तूष्णीमासं मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: I remained silent while hearing your words with the desire of hearing more from you and only spoke a few words by way of reply.

sa: नोचेदयमभाव: स्यात् कुरूणां प्रत्युपस्थितः। अर्थाच्च तात धर्माच्च तव बुद्धिरुपप्लुता॥
en: Otherwise why should the sons of Kuru have come to this state. Your intellect. O dear, has fallen off from both virtue and worldly profit.

sa: राजपुत्रोऽसि भद्रं ते कुले मत्स्यस्य विश्रुते। जातस्त्वं शत्रुदमने नावसीदितुमर्हसि।॥
en: May you fare well. You are a prince born, in the well-known race of Matsya, for vanquishing your enemies. You should not therefore be dispirited.

sa: विसर्जयित्वा मञ्जूषां सम्बोधनभयात् पितुः। विवेश राजभवनं पुनः शोकातुरा ततः॥
en: Laid the basket (on the waters of the Ashva) and entered into the palace with a heavy heart lest her father might know (the secret).

sa: वधार्थमात्मनस्तेन हृता सीता दुरात्मना। नलकूबरशापेन रक्षा चास्याः कृता मया॥
en: It was for his own destruction that Sita was carried off by that wicked-souled (wretch). (But) I protected her (from being violated) through Nalakubera's curse.

sa: कथितस्तेन सुग्रीवस्त्वद्विधैः सचिवैर्वृतः। गम्यतामिति चोक्त्वा मां सीता प्रादादिमं मणिम्॥ धारिता येन वैदेही कालमेतमनिन्दिता। प्रत्ययार्थं कथां चेमां कथयामास जानकी॥
en: He told me “Sugriva is surrounded by such advisers as you" Then asking me to go away Sita gave me this jewel (as a token), which enabled the faultless princess of Videha to bear life so long. And the daughter of Janaka further told me these words as a credential.

sa: यक्ष उवाच धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च परस्परविरोधिनः। एषां नित्यविरुद्धानां कथमेकत्र संगमः॥
en: The Yaksha asked Virtue, profit and desire clash against one another. How can, (therefore) these things ever opposed to one another can be united together?

sa: स्त्रीधू राजसु सर्पषु स्वाध्यायप्रभुशत्रुषु। भोगेष्वायुषि विश्वासं कः प्राज्ञः कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: Women, kings, serpents, one's own lord, enemies, enjoyments and period of life, for what wise man it is proper to put any reliance on these?

sa: धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुत्र त्वां भूमौ संसर्पमाणकम्। अव्यक्तकलवाक्यानि वदन्तं रेणुगुण्ठितम्॥
en: They are also blessed, O son, who will behold you crawl on the ground covered with dust and who will hear your sweet inarticulate speech.

sa: दर्शनीयो मनस्वी च लक्ष्मीवान् ब्रह्मवर्चसी। मेधावी सुकृतप्रज्ञो धर्मात्मा पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: Beautiful, independent, endued with prosperity and with the force of Brahma, intelligent, of great wisdom and of virtuous soul, is that son of Pandu (Yudhishthira).

sa: ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य कवचं शरीरे प्रत्यमुञ्चत। कुमार्यस्तत्र तं दृष्ट्वा प्राहसन् पृथुलोचनाः॥
en: And while by raising it upwards he tried to put the coat of mail on his body, the large-eyed maidens, seeing it, began to laugh.

sa: अचिरेणातिचक्राम खेचरः खे चरनिव। ददर्शाथ पुरीं रम्यां बहुद्वारा मनोरमाम्॥
en: Ranging through the air like a bird he (Ravana) soon cleared a great distance and beheld his beautiful and lovely city adorned with many gates,

sa: एतान्यस्य मृषोक्तानि बहूनि भरतर्षभ। विकत्थनस्य भद्रं ते सदा धर्मार्थलोपिनः॥
en: These are the many unfounded statements that he makes; for he is boastful and regards not either morality or worldly profit. May good betide you.

sa: आगत्य च ततस्तूर्णं तमाचष्ट बृहस्पतेः। अणुमात्रेण वपुषा पद्मतन्त्वाश्रितं प्रभुम्॥
en: And then coming back quickly he gave that information to Brihaspati, namely that the lord having assumed a diminutive form was lying within a lotus.

sa: नेदमद्य युधा शक्यमिन्द्रेणापि सहामरैः। इति व्यवसिताः सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्रा जनार्दन॥
en: All the sons of Dhritarashtra have come to the conclusion that they are now invincible in battle even with Indra himself along with the gods.

sa: शररश्मिरिवादित्यः प्रतस्थे समरे बली। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयः सर्वान प्राच्छादयत् कुरून्॥
en: Like the sun covering (the earth) with rays, the powerful son of Kunti, decked with a diadem, remained in the battle-field covering all with arrows.

sa: गते भीष्मे महाराज धार्तराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। पुनरागम्य तं देशममन्त्रयत मन्त्रिभिः॥
en: O great king, when Bhishma had gone away, that lord of men, the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) again came there and consulted with his counsellors.

sa: त्वयि वत्से पराश्वस्य ब्राह्मणस्याभिराधनम्। तन्मे वाक्यममिथ्या त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि कर्हिचित्॥
en: O child, you will minister to this Brahimana with great skill. And you will act in such a way as not to belie my words.

sa: ततः स पुरुषव्याघ्रः संजहार वपुः स्वकम्। तां दिव्यामद्भुतां चित्रामृद्धिमत्तामरिंदमः॥
en: Then did that best among men, that chastiser of foes, cast off that form and wonderful, which was diverse looking and was endued with prosperity.

sa: उद्धरन्निव कायेभ्यः शिरांसि शरवृष्टिभिः। अपि बाणमयं तेजः प्रदीप्तमिव सर्वतः॥
en: And by his shower of arrows separating heads from the bodies. (I see) also his strength in the shape of arrows blazing in all directions.

sa: साश्वः सरथपादातः स्वस्ति गच्छ जयद्रथ। एवमुक्तस्तु सव्रीडं तूष्णीं किंचिदवाड्मुखः॥
en: O Jayadratha, go now in peace with your charioteers, cavalry and infantry." Being this accosted he was filled with shame; then bending low his head,

sa: न चेदिदं कर्म नरेन्द्र वध्यं न चेद् भवेत् सुकृतं निष्फलं वा। इदं च तच्चाभिसमीक्ष्य नूनं पराजयो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य साधुः॥
en: This act, O chief of me, (sending us into exile and themselves possessing our kingdom) cannot but be wicked; and all our good deeds cannot be totally devoid of good fruits. Having considered this as well as that (I think that) the defeat of the son of Dhritarashtra is certain.

sa: उष्ट्रप्रयुक्तमारूढो भीष्मद्रोणी महारथौ। मया साधु महाबाहो धार्तराष्ट्रेण वा विभो॥
en: Ascending camels the ten great carwarriors, Bhishma and Drona along with myself, O you of arms, and also with the son of Dhritarashtra, O lord,

sa: स्वयोनि भजते सर्वो विशस्वापोऽविशङ्कितः। अहं त्वां वर्धयिष्यामि ब्राझैर्मन्त्रैः सनातनैः॥
en: Everything accepts that which comes from it, enter the waters without any fear. I shall make you strong by reciting eternal hymns relating to Brahma.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षे वागासीत् सुभगा लोकसाक्षिणी। पुण्या संहर्षणी तेषां वानराणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Then a sacred and auspicious voice, joyful to the high-souled monkeys, was heard in the firmament which made the whole universe bear testimony to it.

sa: स समीक्ष्यक्रमोपेतो मुख्यः कालोऽयमागतः। अस्मिश्चेदागते काले कार्यं न प्रतिपद्यसे॥
en: This is the time now for showing your prowess; and this suitable time having now arrived, if you do not resort to the proper action,

sa: प्रध्यानसमकालं तु प्रजाहेतोः सनातनः। ध्यातमात्रे तु भगवन्नाभ्यां पद्मः समुत्थितः॥
en: As soon as the Eternal deity engaged in thought for the creation of progeny a lotus sprang up from the navel of the Divine Lord.

sa: पात्रीभूतश्च कौन्तेयो ब्राह्मणो गुणवानिव। शरौघान् प्रतिगृह्णातु मया मुक्तान् सहस्रशः॥
en: Like a Brahmana, gifted with good qualities the son of Kunti has become the proper person to receive quietly thousands of arrow shot by me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रत्याख्यातो राजपुत्र्या सुदेष्णां कीचकोऽब्रवीत्। अमर्यादेन कामेन घोरेणाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Rejected thus by the princess Kichaka, over-pressed with fearful lust capable of making one forgetful of all sense of propriety, said to Sudeshna.

sa: समाकुला मही राजन् कुरुपाण्डवकारणात्। तदा समभवत् कृत्स्ना सम्प्रयाणे महीक्षिताम्॥
en: At that time, o king the earth became crowded with the throng of kings who had come either for the Kauravas or for the Pandavas.

sa: समवेक्ष्येह धर्मार्थो सम्भारान् योऽधिगच्छति। स वै सम्भृतसम्भारः सततः सुखमेधते॥
en: He, who having paid due regard to virtue and worldly gains seeks the acquirement of success, gets what he wants and ever is in happiness.

sa: यस्य नागायुतैर्वीर्यं भुजयोः सारमर्पितम्। तेन वो भीमसेनेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: By him whose substantial arms the strength of ten thousands has been given by the aid of such Brahmana will the Pandavas fight with you.

sa: भगवन् मम नेत्राणामन्तर्धानं वृणे पुनः। भवन्तं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि नान्यं द्रष्टुमिहोत्सहे॥
en: O lord, I again pray for the restoration of my eyes, for I want to see you and I desire not to see anything else."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच संजयश्चेतनां लब्ध्वा प्रत्याश्वस्येदमब्रवीत्। धृतराष्ट्र महाराज सभायां कुरुसंसदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Sanjaya having regained consciousness and being comforted addressed these words to the great king, Dhritarashtra, amidst that assemblage of Kurus in that hall.

sa: सर्व एते महात्मानो बुद्धिमन्तो महाबलाः। अलं तव विनाशाय रामवीर्यबलाश्रयात्॥
en: All these are endued with magnanimity, intellect and great strength; and being backed up by the strength of Rama are surely able to kill you."

sa: जनमेजय उवाच युधिष्ठिरं सहानीकमुपायान्तं युयुत्सया। संनिविष्टं कुरुक्षेत्रे वासुदेवेन पालितम्॥
en: Janamejaya said Hearing that Yudhishthira with his army was advancing with the desire of fighting and has already reached Kurukshetra and was protected by Vasudeva,

sa: या मे प्रीतिः पुष्कराक्ष त्वदर्शनसमुद्भवा। सा किमाख्यायते तुभ्यमन्तरात्माऽसि देहिनाम्॥
en: What is the use of describing the pleasure I feel, owing of my seeing you; for you are the universal soul of all embodies creatures.

sa: तं पिता परमक्रुद्धो ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः। शशाप पुत्रं गान्धारे राज्याच्चापि व्यरोपयत्।॥
en: His father, Yayati, born of Nahusha being very much angry with him, cursed his son, O son of Gandhari and exiled him from the kingdom.

sa: वीर्यवत्त्वं दुतं चाग्नयं दृष्ट्वा जिष्णोरपूजयन्॥ कालाग्निमिव बीभत्सुं निर्दहन्तमिव प्रजाः।
en: And seeing him endued with energy prowess and quick motion people began to adore Vishnu like fire burning at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य मण्डलं सव्यमेव च। कुरून् सम्मोहयामास मत्स्यो यानेन तत्त्ववित्॥
en: A skillful charioteer as he was the Matsya Prince, sometimes wheeling about, sometimes proceeding in circles and again turning to the left, bewildered the Kurus.

sa: एहि त्वामभिषेक्ष्यामि मत्स्यराजस्तु नो भवान्॥ मनसश्चाप्यभिप्रेतं यथेष्टं भुवि दुर्लभम्।
en: Come, I shall install you and be the king of us, the Matsya's. Whatever you desire in mind, any thing, even though rare on earth,

sa: अशक्याश्चैव ये केचिद् पृथिव्यां शूरमानिनः। सर्वांस्तानर्जुनः पार्थः कल्पयामास भागतः॥
en: Whoever there is in this world who boasts that he is invincible. Arjuna, the son Pritha, has accepted all of them also as his share.

sa: दुर्योधनः सहसुतः सार्धं भ्रातृशतेन च। प्राच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च भीमसेनस्य भागतः॥
en: Duryodhana with his son and his hundred brothers and the soldiers coming from the castern and southern countries have fallen to the share of Bhimasena.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः कमिवाद्य न शातयेत्। शत्रुमध्ये शरान् मुञ्चन् देवराडशनीमिव॥
en: What man is there is this world whom Dhrishtadyumna cannot vanquish, shooting arrows among the enemy like the king of the gods hurling his thunderbolt.

sa: निराहारस्तु स मुनिरुञ्छमार्जयते पुनः। न चैनं विक्रियां नेतुमशकन्मुद्गलं क्षुधा।॥
en: Thereupon without eating any food himself, the Rishi Mudgala again became engaged in collecting corn, following the Unccha mode. Hunger could not disturb his equanimity,

sa: नरहस्तिस्थाश्वानां सारं मध्यं च फल्गु च। सर्वेष्वेतेष्वनीकेषु संदिदेश नराधिपः॥
en: He divided his men, elephants, chariots and horses into superior, inferior inferior and indifferent; and then that ruler of men distributed them in his army.

sa: खगांश्च दीप्तान् दीर्घाश्च कलापांश्च महाधनान्। विपाठान् क्षुरधारांश्च धनुर्भिनिदधुः सह॥
en: Along with their bows they deposited their long and shining swords, quivers of great value, and arrows with edges as sharp as those of razors.

sa: वरुणो निर्जितो राजा पावकश्वामितौजसा। पारिजातं च हरता जितः साक्षाच्छचीपतिः॥
en: The Varuna too was defeated as also fire of immeasurable energy and even the lord of Sachi himself was overpowered when robbing the Parijat flower.

sa: समीननागनक्रं च खमिवारोप्यते जलम्। वायुना चैव महता पक्षवातेन चानिशम्॥
en: The water, along with its fishes, snakes and crocodiles, seems to rise up continually to the sky by the great wind caused by your wings,

sa: तस्य राज्ञः सुतो वीरः श्रीमान् सत्यपराक्रमः। क्रमप्राप्तं पितुः स्वं यो राज्यं समनुशास्ति ह॥ नलो नामारिहा श्यामः पुण्यश्लोक इति श्रुतः। ब्रह्मण्यो वेदविद् वाग्मी पुण्यकृत् सोमपोऽग्निमान्।। यष्टा दाता च योद्धा च सम्यक् चैव प्रशासिता। तस्य मामबलां श्रेष्ठां विद्धि भार्यामिहागताम्॥ त्यक्तश्रियं भर्तृहीनामनाथां व्यसनान्विताम्। अन्वेषमाणां भर्तारं त्वं मां पर्वतसत्तम॥
en: The son of this king, a mighty warrior, possessed of prosperity and of infallible prowess, who govern well the kingdom that he had inherited from his father, is known under the name of Nala of holy fame, of complexion like molten gold. He is respectful towards Brahmanas, versed in the Vedas, eloquent and performer of meritorious deeds; he is used to the drinking of Soma and the worship of Fire; he celebrates sacrifices, is immensely charitable and heroic and a just chastiser (of sinful) men. Know me for his principal consort now helpless and come unto you. O excellent of mountains! devoid of prosperity, deprived of the company of my husband, helpless and distressed with affliction, in quest of my lord I have approached you.

sa: ततः स्फाटिकतोयां वै स्फाटिकाम्बुजशोभिताम्। वापी मत्वा स्थलमिव सवासाः प्रापतज्जले॥
en: Some after, he mistook a lake of crystal water, adorned with crystal water flowers for land and fell into it with all his clothes on.

sa: यातुधाना हि बहवो राक्षसाः पर्वतोपमाः। त्वयाभिगुप्तं कौन्तेयं न विवर्तेयुरन्तिकम्॥
en: The way is beset with many Rakshasas, huge as mountains. If protected by you, they will not be able to approach the sons of Kunti.

sa: दानवानां विनाशाय अस्त्राणां परमं बलम्। चाहितस्त्वं महेन्द्रेण पुरुषेन्द्र तदुत्तमम्॥
en: O best of mortals, in order to destroy these Danavas, Mahendra conferred on you the energy (that belongs to the possessor) of those excellent weapons.

sa: अत्र वै पुत्रशोकेन वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः। बद्ध्वाऽऽत्मानं निपतितो विपाशः पुनरुत्थितः॥
en: Here from the grief at his son's death, the great Rishi Vasishtha threw himself into the Vipasa after first binding himself, but he rose again.

sa: लोमश उवाच यथाश्रुतमिदं पूर्वमस्माभिररिकर्शन। तदेकाग्रमना राजन् निबोध गदतो मम॥
en: Lomasha said : O chastiser of foes, O king, I shall tell detail all that we heard about them before. Hear them with all attention.

sa: तत्र स्थित्वा नरश्रेष्ठं भगीरथमुवाच ह। प्रयाचस्व महाबाहो शैलराजसुतां नदीम्॥
en: Remaining there he thus spoke to that best of men, Bhagiratha, “O mighty-armed hero, pray to the river, the daughter of the king of mountains.

sa: इन्द्रे ह्यस्त्राणि दिव्यानि समस्तानिधनंजय। वृत्राद् भीतैर्बलं देवैस्तदा शक्रे समर्पितम्॥
en: O Dhananjaya, all celestials weapons are with Indra. The celestials at one time gave all their strength to Shakra (Indra) from the fear of Vitra.

sa: तत एनं परिश्रान्तमुपलक्ष्य वृकोदरः। योक्त्रयामास बाहुभ्यां पशुं रशनया यथा॥
en: Finding him (the Rakshasas) fatigued, Vrikodara (Bhima) twined his own arm round the body of the enemy, as one binds a beast with a cord.

sa: तत्र कूपे महाराज विश्रुता भरतर्षभ। समुद्रास्तत्र चत्वारो निवसन्ति युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O great king, ever steady in war O best of the Bharata race, O Yudhishthira, there is a celebrated well, in which four seas exist.

sa: व्यतिक्रमं मे भगवन् क्षन्तुमर्हसि शंकर। भगवन् दर्शनाकाक्षी प्राप्तोऽस्मीमं महागिरिम्॥
en: O exalted one, O Shankara, you should pardon my fault. It was to get a sight of yourself that I came to this great mountain.

sa: अग्निरात्मभवं प्रादाद् यत्र वाञ्छति नैषधः॥ लोकानात्मप्रभांश्चैव ददौ तस्मै हुताशनः।
en: Agni gave assurance of his own presence wherever the king of the Nishadhas would wish. Hutashana also granted to him regions as resplendent as himself.

sa: इष्टयः पशुबन्धाश्च काम्यनैमित्तिकाश्च ये। वर्तन्ते पाकयज्ञाश्च यज्ञकर्म च नित्यदा॥
en: Ishtis, Pashubandhas, sacrifice for obtaining the gratification of desires and ordinary household ceremonies, Paka sacrifices and various other rites are daily performed in your house.

sa: चमू विगाह्य शत्रूणां शरशक्तिसमाकुलाम्। यदा सिंहरवं वीर करिष्यसि महाबला॥
en: By rushing into the enemy's force armed with numerous arrows and javelins when you shall give forth lion-like roars, O hero, O greatly powerful one,

sa: एवमुक्तस्तथा वायुरन्तरिक्षादभाषत। नैषा कृतवती पापं नल सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Brihadashva said : Thus spoken the wind-god addressed from above, saying, “O Nala, I tell you the truth that she had not committed any sin.

sa: मोहात्मकं तमस्तेषां रज एषां प्रवर्तकम्। प्रकाशबहुलत्वाच्च सत्त्वं ज्याय इहोच्यते॥
en: Tama is characterised by illusion, Raja incites men to action, Sattva is of great splendour and therefore it is called the greatest of them all.

sa: दुर्योधनस्य शान्त्यर्थमिति निश्चित्य भूमिपः। धृतराष्ट्रो महाराज प्राहिणोद् विदुराय वै॥
en: Vaishampayana said O great king, having resolved to pacify Duryodhana the ruler of earth, Dhritarashtra, sent men to Vidura to summon him (before his presence).

sa: ततोऽभिगम्य कौन्तेयः शिरसाभ्यगमद् बली। स चैनं वृत्तपीनाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां प्रत्यगृहणत॥
en: Thereupon approaching him the powerful son of Kunti saluted him bending his head low; he (Indra) too embraced him with his round and plump arms.

sa: स तत्र पूज्यमाना वै दमयन्ती व्यनन्दत। सर्वकामैः सुविहितैर्निरुद्वेगावसत् तदा॥
en: Damayanti was highly gratified with the respectful behaviour of her companion; and she lived there for some time, because all her desires were excellently satisfied.

sa: ततः प्रस्थापयामास किमेतदिति पार्थिवः। तस्मै क्षत्ता यथावृत्तमाचचक्षे सुतं प्रति॥
en: The king sent for information as to what it was about. And the royal usher then explained to him what had happened to his son.

sa: इमां गाथामत्र गायन्नपः स्पृशति यो नरः। देवयानोऽस्य पन्थाश्च चक्षुषाभिप्रकाशते॥
en: The man, who bathes at this spot and recites this ancient story, sees with his human eyes the path that leads to the celestials region.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भगवन्नार्थ माहैतद् यथावद्धर्मनिश्चयम्। यथाशक्ति यथान्यायं क्रियते विधिवन्मया॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O adorable one, the duties just mentioned by you are indeed excellent and I perform them properly to the best of my ability.

sa: यद् भूतहितमत्यन्तं तत् सत्यमिति धारणा। विपर्ययकृतोऽधर्मः पश्य धर्मस्य सूक्ष्मताम्॥
en: Whatever conduces to the greatest good of all creatures is considered to be the truth. Virtue is thus perverted. Do you mark its subtle ways?

sa: वितस्तां च समासाद्य संतर्घ्य पितृदेवताः। नरः फलमवाप्नोति वाजपेयस्य भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, going to Vitasta and offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials a man obtains the fruits of the Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sa: इयं वस्त्रावकर्तेन संवीता चारुहासिनी। उन्मत्तेव वरारोहा कथं बुद्ध्वा भविष्यति॥
en: How will this sweet smiling and slenderwaisted Damayanti live, when awaking, she shall find herself clothed, like one mad, in half a piece of cloth?

sa: निरुच्छ् वासोऽभवच्चैव संनिरुद्धो महात्मना। पपात भूम्यां निश्चेष्टो गतसत्त्व इवाभवत्॥
en: Pressed by the high-souled deity, he became breathless and falling on the ground without the power of moving, he looked like one who was dead.

sa: त्वयि प्रतिष्ठिते साधो रथस्थे स्थिरवाजिनि। पश्चादहमथारोक्ष्ये सुकृती सत्पथ यथा।॥
en: O sage, after you have mounted it, after horses have become quiet, I will mount it like a pious man following the road of honesty.

sa: चोलपाण्ड्यावपि द्वारं न लेभाते ह्युपस्थितौ। समुद्रसारं वैदूर्यं मुक्तासङ्घांस्तथैव च॥
en: Were brought by the kings of Chola and Pandya yet they could not get admittance. That best of sea-born gems, Vaidurya and heap of pearls.

sa: निषादभूमि गोशृङ्गं पर्वतप्रवरं तथा। तरसैवाजयद् धीमान् श्रेणिमन्तं च पार्थिवम्॥
en: The greatly intelligent (Sahadeva) then soon conquered the country of the Nishadas and also the best of hills, called Goshringa, and the king, called Shrenimana.

sa: अवधानेन सुभगे नित्योत्थिततयैव च। भर्तारो वशगा मह्यं गुरुशुश्रूषयैव च॥
en: O blessed lady, my husband has become obedient to me for my diligence, my alacrity and for the humility with which I serve my Gurus.

sa: वीडिता साभवत् साध्वी तदा भरतसत्तम। भिक्षामादाय विप्राय निर्जगाम यशस्विनी॥
en: Remembering this she was ashamed. Then, O foremost of the Bharata race, that chaste and famous lady went away to give alms to the Brahmanas.

sa: एतद् वै मानुषेणाद्य न शक्यं द्रष्टुमद्भुतम्। समाधि कुरुताव्यग्रास्तीर्थान्येतानि द्रक्ष्यथ॥
en: No man is able to get a sight of this wonder. Therefore concentrate your mind, so that you may with rapt attention see these Tirthas.

sa: एषा यजनभूमिर्हि देवानामभिसंस्कृता। तत्र दत्तं सूक्ष्ममपि महद् भवति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, this sacrificial place is worshipped by the celestials themselves. If a man gives away here only a little, it increases thousand-fold.

sa: भीमसेनस्तमालोक्य नेत्रे उत्फाल्य लोहिते। प्रोवाच राजमध्ये तं सभां विश्रावयन्निव॥
en: Seeing this Bhimasena, expanding his red eyes, thus spoke to him (Duryodhana) in the midst of the kings, as if piercing them (with his words).

sa: न मातृपितृवद् राजन्धाता भूतेषु वर्तते। रोषादिव प्रवृत्तोऽयं यथायमितरो जनः॥
en: O king, the Providence behaves towards the creatures, like a father or mother, like an ordinary person he (sometimes) seems to be angry towards them.

sa: साक्षादत्र श्वेतकेतुर्ददर्श सरस्वतीं मानुषदेहरूपाम्। वेत्स्यामि वाणीमिति सम्प्रवृत्तां सरस्वतीं श्वेतकेतुर्बभाषे।॥
en: Here did Shvatakatu see Sarasvati herself in her heavenly form. Shvatakatu said to Sarasvati when she appeared, “Make me endued with the gift of speech.”

sa: पुन तेन मां जित्वा वनवासं सुदारुणम्। प्रावाजयन् महारण्यमजिनैः परिवारितम्॥
en: And defeating me at dice a second time, they have exiled me into the fearful woods, where I lead a disastrous life, clad in deer-skin.

sa: विहितः सर्वथैवासौ ममात्मा भूतभावनः। अर्धं मम शरीरस्य सर्वलोक पितामहः॥
en: Everything has been ordained by my soul which is the source of all existence. The Grandsire of all the worlds is half of my body.

sa: द्वीपोऽभवद् यत्र वृकोदरस्य युधिष्ठिरोधर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः। अमोक्षयद् यस्तमनन्ततेजा ग्राहेण संवेष्टितसर्वगात्रम्॥
en: (But) Yudhishthira, of immeasurable prowess, became the liberator of Vrikodara and extricated him from the gripe of the snake which coiled round his whole body.

sa: एषा गङ्गा सप्तविधा राजते भरतर्षभ। स्थानं विरजसं पुण्यं यत्राग्निर्नित्यमिध्यते॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, here flow before you the seven Ganges. This spot is (very) pure and holy. Here Agni unceasingly blazes forth.

sa: ततः शक्रेण संदिष्टश्चित्रसेनो ममान्तिकम्। प्राप्तः कमलपत्राक्ष स च मामब्रवीदथ॥
en: O lotus-eyed one, therefore at the command of Shakra. (Indra), Chitrasena came to me; and arriving at my house, he then thus spoke to me.

sa: सभाग्याः कुरवश्चमे ये न दग्धास्त्वयानचे। अरिष्टं व्रज पन्थानं मदनुध्यानबृंहिता॥
en: The Kurus are (very) fortunate that they have not been burnt by your wrath. O siniess one, go away in safety, blessed by my prayer.

sa: देवकार्यं तु सुमहत् त्वया कार्यमरिंदम आरोढव्यस्त्वया स्वर्गः सज्जीभव महाद्युते॥
en: O subduer of enemies, you of great effulgence, a great work for gods should be performed by you; you are to ascend heaven, prepare yourself.

sa: सरिद्भिः सविहङ्गाभिः शिखरैश्च समाकुलम्। गिरिराजमिमं तावत् पृच्छामि नृपतिं प्रति॥
en: The mountain abounding in rivers infested by water fowls; and decorated with crested summits. Now I ask about king Nala from the king of mountain.

sa: तं वै राजा सत्यधृतिर्महात्मा अजातशत्रुर्विदुरं यथावत्। स्ततोऽपृच्छद् धृतराष्ट्र सपुत्रम्॥
en: The illustrious and enemiless descendant of Ajamida, ever devoted to truth, reverentially saluted Vidura and asked him about the welfare of Dhritarashtra and his sons.

sa: नाभिजज्ञे स नृपतिर्दुहित्रर्थे समागतम्। ऋतुपर्णोऽपि राजा सधीमान् सत्यपराक्रमः॥ राजानं राजपुत्रं वा न स्म पश्यति कंचन। नैव स्वयंवरकथां न च विप्रसमागमम्॥ ततो व्यगणयद् राजा मनसा कोसलाधिपः। आगतोऽस्मीत्युवाचैनं भवन्तमभिवादकः॥
en: In fact Bhima did not know that he (Rituparna) had come to win the hands of his daughter. The intelligent king Rituparna, possessed of unbaffled power, beheld that there was neither a king nor a prince; nor he saw any gathering of Brahmanas; nor he heard any talk regarding the Svayamvara. Thereupon the ruler of Koshala ineditated in his mind and after a while addressed him, saying, "I have como here to pay you homage?"

sa: अहं पूर्वमगस्त्येन कुद्धेन परमर्षिणा। शप्तोऽपराधे कस्मिंश्चित् तस्यैषा निष्कृतिः कृता॥
en: Formerly I was cursed by the great sage Agastya in anger for some offence. You have freed me from it by this act (of yours).

sa: तैः समेत्य विनिश्चित्य सोऽनुज्ञातो महीपते। ययौ मिथुनमारोग्य विदर्भास्तेन वाहिना॥
en: O lord of earth! deciding (the matter) with their aid and with their permission placing the children on the chariot the charioteer hastened towards Vidarbha.

sa: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये स्नाति यः संगमे नरः। दशाश्वमेधानाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: The man, who bathes at the confluence of the Ganga and the Yamuna, obtains the fruits of ten Ashvamedha sacrifice and saves his own race.

sa: प्रकाल्यमानस्तेनायं शृलहप्तेन रक्षसा। अग्न्यागारं प्रति द्वारि मया दोऱ्यां निवारितः॥
en: He was pursued by a Rakshasha with uplifted spear; and he attempted to enter this room, but he was stopped at the door by me.

sa: ते तु वृत्रं समाश्रित्य नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः। समन्तात् पर्यधावन्त महेन्द्रप्रमुखान् सुरान्॥
en: Placing themselves under the command of) Vritra and arming themselves with various weapons, they pursued the celestials with Indra at their head to all directions.

sa: अथाब्रवीद् द्विजः कश्चिदर्जुनस्य प्रियः सखा। स एष्यति महाबाहुर्वशी शौरिरुदारधीः॥
en: And a certain Brahmana said "Shauri, the dear friend of Arjuna, of mighty arms, possessed of self-restraint and endued with high intellect, will come (here).

sa: एतदाहुर्महेन्द्रस्य राज्ञो वैश्रवणस्य च। ऋषयः सर्वधर्मज्ञाः सद्म तात मनीषिणः॥
en: O child, it is said by the intelligent sages, acquainted with all duties, that this (region) is the abode of Mahendra and of king Vaisravana.

sa: स ते दास्यति राजर्षियजमानोऽर्थितोधनम्। तत आदाय विप्रर्षे प्रतिगृह्यधनं बहु॥
en: That royal sage engaged in horse sacrifice will give you the wealth begged by you. Then, O Brahmanic sage, having received from him vast wealth,

sa: स्पृशेयं तेन सत्येन पादावेतौ महीपते। यथा नासत्कृतं किंचिन्मनसापि चराम्यहम्॥
en: O lord of the earth, touching these your feet, I can truly swear that even in thought I have not committed any sort of crime.

sa: ततः कुन्तीसुतो राजा लघुभिाह्मणैः सह। लोमशेन च सुप्रीतस्त्रिरात्रं काम्यकेऽवसत्॥
en: Thereupon, the son of Kunti, the king (Yudhishthira) with only a few Brahmanas lived in the Kaimyaka (forest) for three nights, much cleared by Lomasha.

sa: निर्वाणं नाधिगच्छेयुर्जीवेयुः पशुजीविकाम्। विद्यां ते नैव युज्येयुर्न चार्थ केचिदाप्नुयुः॥
en: None would have followed emancipation, none would have cared for the acquisition of knowledge or even of wealth and people would have lived like beasts.

sa: सेकानपरसेकांश्च व्यजयत् सुमहाबलः। करं तेभ्य उपादाय रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: The greatly powerful hero then subjugated the Sekas and the other Sekas, and exacted tribute from them in the shape of various gems and jewels.

sa: पादौ शूद्रा भवन्तीमे विक्रमेण क्रमेण च। ऋग्वेदः सामवेदश्च यजुर्वेदोऽप्यथर्वणः॥
en: From my feet the Shudras, one after the other, sprang up through my great energy. The Rig, the Sama, the Yaju and the Atharva Vedas,

sa: स वाक्यं कुरुवीरस्य स्मितेन प्रतिगृह्य तत्। हनूमान् वायुतनयो वायुपुत्रमभाषत।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing the words of that Kuru hero, Hanuman smiled and that son of Vayu thus spoke to the son of Vayu (Bhima).

sa: अहं प्रजापतिर्ब्रह्मा मत्परं नाधिगम्यते। मत्स्यरूपेण यूयं च मयास्मान्मोक्षिता भयात्॥
en: “I am the Lord of creatures, Brahma; none is greater than myself. In ihe form of a fish I have saved you from this fear.

sa: कथं डराजा दाशार्हो मध्ये सर्वमहीक्षिताम्। अर्हणामर्हति तथा यथा युष्माभिरर्चितः॥
en: How does this man of the Dasarha race, who is not a king, deserve to be worshipped among these kings that you have worshipped him?

sa: ततः प्रव्यथिता भूमिळशीर्यत समन्ततः। आर्ता स्कन्दं समासाद्य पुनर्बलवती बभौ॥
en: The earth was greatly afflicted and she was bereft off all her ornaments. She went to Skanda and she again became as shining as before.

sa: तत: शिलाः समादाय मुहूर्तमिव भारत। महाभैरिव शैलेन्द्रौ युयुधाते महाबलौ॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, they instantly took up rocks; and those two greatly strong heroes fought like a mountain and a great mass of clouds.

sa: यस्तु वर्षशतं पूर्णमग्निहोत्रमुपासते।॥ कार्तिकी वा वसेदेकां पुष्करे सममेव तत्॥
en: He who performs the sacred Agnihotra for one hundred years acquires the same mcrit as he who lives only one month of Kartikeya in Pushkara.

sa: बृहत्सेने व्रजामात्यानानाय्य नलशासनात्। आचक्ष्व यद्भूतं द्रव्यमवशिष्टं च यद् वसु॥
en: 'O Brihadsena! inviting all the ministers in the name of king Nala, go and inform them what things are lost and what wealth still remains.

sa: लोमश उवाच शृणु राजन् कथां दिव्यामद्भुतामतिमानुषीम्। अगस्त्यस्य महाराज प्रभावममितौजसः॥
en: Lomasha said : O king, O great monarch, listen to the excellent, wonderful and extraordinary account of Agastya and also about his immeasurably effulgent prowess.

sa: हा नाथ मामिह वने ग्रस्यामानामनाथवत्। ग्राहेणानेन विजने किमर्थं नानुधावसि॥
en: 'O lord! why do you not run after me, seeing that I am swallowed by this huge serpent like one helpless, in this desolate wilderness?

sa: ववृधे सा महाराज बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम्। अप्स्विवोत्पलिनी शीघ्रमग्नेरिव शिखा शुभा।॥
en: O king, possessed with great beauty that blessed girl began to grow quickly like a lotus in water or the blazing flame in a fire.

sa: तेषु तेषु हि कृत्येषु विनियोक्ता महेश्वरः। सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय कारयत्यवशान्यपि॥
en: O son of Kunti, it is the supreme Lord of all who makes all creatures do what they do, though they themselves are all inert.

sa: ततः प्रवर्तते पश्चात् कारणैस्तस्य सिद्धये। तां सिद्धिमुपजीवन्ति कर्मजामिह जन्तवः॥
en: Thereupon they set themselves, by instruinents, to accomplishing them; and creatures maintain their lives by the results acquired in these directions by their own acts.

sa: तथोक्ता तेन सार्थेन दमयन्ती नृपात्मजा। प्रत्युवाच ततः साध्वी भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता॥
en: Thus spoken to by the men of the caravan, the princess Damayanti, devoted to her husband and greatly oppressed with sorrow replied to them thus..

sa: भजेत् सर्वात्मना चैव प्रद्युम्नजननी तथा। भानुप्रभृतिभिश्चैनान् विशिनष्टि च केशवः॥
en: The mother of Pradyumna also loves them with all their heart. Keshava (Krishna) with his sons Bhanu and others watches over them with special affection.

sa: न चक्षमे ततो राजा समाह्वानं महामनाः। वैदाः प्रेक्षमाणायाः पणकालममन्यत॥
en: Thereupon the illustrious monarch could not desire to reject the summons. For the reason of Damayanti's presence there, he fixed the time for game also.

sa: तं ददर्श यवक्रीतो यत्नवन्तं निबन्धने। प्रहसंश्चाब्रवीद् वाक्यमिदं स मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: When that foremost of Rishis, Yavakrit, saw him thus earnestly engaged in bridging (the Ganges), he broke out into a loud laughter and thus spoke.

sa: हिरण्यष्ठीविनः कांश्चित् पक्षिणो वनगोचरान्। गृहे किल कृतावासान् लोभाद् राजा न्यपीडयत्। स चोपभोगलोभान्धो हिरण्यार्थी परंतप॥ आयतिं च तदात्वं च उभे सद्यो व्यनाशयत्। तदर्थकामस्तद्वत् त्वं मा दुहः पाण्डवान् नृप॥
en: It is said that a (certain) king, having (first) made some wild birds which used to vomit gold to take up their quarters in his own house, killed them afterwards from temptation. O chastiser of foes, blinded by temptation and by the desire of enjoyinent he destroyed both his present and future for the sake of the gold. O king, O monarch like that king, do not persecute the Pandavas from the desire of gain.

sa: स तस्य पदमुन्नीय तस्मादेवाश्रमात् प्रभुः। मृगयामास कौन्तेयो भीमसेनं महावने॥
en: Then the royal son of Kunti left that hermitage and tracing his (Bhima's) foot prints began to search about for Bhimasena in that mighty forest.

sa: सुधन्वना तथोक्तः सन् व्यथितोऽश्वत्थपर्णवत्। जगाम कश्यपं दैत्यः परिप्रष्टुं महौजसम्॥
en: When Sudhanva thus spoke, the Daitya (Prahlada) trembling like a leaf of the fig tree went to the greatly effulgent Kashyapa, to consult with him.

sa: तत्र युद्धमभूद् राजन् दिवसद्वयमच्युत्॥ स विजित्य दुराधर्ष भीष्मकं माद्रिनन्दनः।
en: O king, O Achyuta (unfolding glory), a great battle was fought there for two days. But the son of Madri, Sahadeva, defeated the invincible Bhishmaka.

sa: कैरातं वेषमास्थाय योधयामास फाल्गुनम्। जिज्ञासुः सर्वदेवेशः कपर्दी भगवान् स्वयम्॥
en: The exalted lord of all the gods, Kapardin (Shiva) himself, having assumed the disguise of a Kirata, fought with Falguni (Arjuna) to test his prowess.

sa: तमब्रवीद्धर्मराजो ह्रियमाणो युधिष्ठिरः। धर्मस्ते हीयते मूढ न तत्त्वं समवेक्षसे॥
en: Having been thus stolen (by the Rakshasa), Dharmaraja Yudhishthira thus spoke to him, "O fool virtue decreases in you; you do not look to it.

sa: स ब्राह्मणान् पर्यपृच्छत् तपोयुक्तान् मनीषिणः। प्रवर्षणे सुरेन्द्रस्य समर्थान् पृथिवीपते॥
en: O ruler of earth, he asked the Brahmanas who were intelligent, able and fit how rain might be poured by the lord of the celestials.

sa: मयापि सहधर्मज्ञ तीर्थान्येतान्यनुक्रमात्। प्राप्स्यसे महतीं कीर्तिं यथा राजा महाभिषः।।१२४
en: You can go with me O virtuous man, to visit some of the Tirthas. You will by this obtain great fame as did king Mahavisha,

sa: नातः पापीयसी काचिदापद् राजन् भविष्यति। यन्नो नीचरैल्पबलै राज्यमाच्छिद्य भुज्यते॥
en: O king, what greater calamity would befall us than that our kingdom should be snatched away from us and enjoyed by weak and contemptible foes!

sa: ततः पूर्वोत्तरे देशे समुद्रस्य महीपते। विदार्य पातालमथ संक्रुद्धाः सगरात्मजाः॥
en: O ruler of men, the sons of Sagara then dug the sea in anger on its north eastern region till they reached the nether region.

sa: कुमित्राण्यनपाश्रित्य किं वै सुखतरं ततः। यत्राहानि न गण्यन्ते नैनमाहुर्महाशनम्॥
en: And he who has no wicked friend, who is happier than he? He in whose case the day is not counted is not called voracious.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धन्या वयं यदस्माकं स्नेहकारुण्ययन्त्रिताः। असतोऽपि गुणानाहुर्ब्राह्मणप्रमुखाः प्रजाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Blessed are we, since moved by affection and compassion, our subjects, headed by the Brahmanas, credit us with merits we do not possess.

sa: पुण्यकीर्ती राजपुत्री द्रौपदी वीरसूयिरम्॥ विश्रुता कथमज्ञाता कृष्णा पार्थ चरिष्यति।
en: The mother of heroes, the princess Draupadi of virtuous deeds. O son of Pritha, how will this Krishna be able to live undiscovered and unknown?
